name: "CI: Test Models"

# This workflow tests all supported Cua models with API keys
# Runs weekly on Monday or manually via workflow_dispatch

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      test_models:
        description: "Test all supported models (requires API keys)"
        required: false
        default: true
        type: boolean
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 9 * * 1'  # Every Monday at 9:00 UTC

env:
  # Cua programs and packages run here never send usage telemetry.
  CUA_TELEMETRY: "0"
  DO_NOT_TRACK: "1"

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  # Single source of truth for the model list: .github/model-matrix.txt.
  # `test-all-models` and `test-summary` both derive from this job's output, so
  # the matrix and the summary's EXPECTED_MODELS filter cannot drift apart.
  resolve-models:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      models: ${{ steps.list.outputs.models }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Read model matrix
        id: list
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Strip comments (whole-line and trailing) and blank lines, then emit
          # a compact JSON array for `fromJSON`.
          models=$(sed -e 's/[[:space:]]*#.*$//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//' \
            .github/model-matrix.txt | grep -v '^$' | jq -R . | jq -sc .)
          if [ "$models" = "[]" ]; then
            echo "::error::.github/model-matrix.txt lists no models." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "models=$models" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Resolved models: $models"

  # Test all Cua models - runs on PRs, pushes to main, or when manually triggered
  test-all-models:
    needs: resolve-models
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        model: ${{ fromJSON(needs.resolve-models.outputs.models) }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up uv and Python
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@38f3f104447c67c051c4a08e39b64a148898af3a # v4
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Cache system packages
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: /var/cache/apt
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-apt-${{ hashFiles('**/Dockerfile') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-apt-

      - name: Install system dependencies
        timeout-minutes: 20
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libgl1-mesa-dri libglib2.0-0

      - name: Cache Python dependencies (uv)
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cache/uv
            .venv
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-uv-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml', 'uv.lock', 'libs/python/**/pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-uv-

      - name: Install Cua dependencies (uv)
        run: |
          # Remove existing venv if it exists (from cache restore) to avoid interactive prompt
          rm -rf .venv
          uv venv --python 3.12
          uv pip install -e libs/python/agent -e libs/python/computer
          uv pip install -e libs/python/core
          uv pip install "cua-agent[uitars-hf,internvl-hf,opencua-hf,moondream3]"
          # The omniparser+ models need cua-som (deprecated, AGPL-3.0), which
          # cua-agent no longer pulls in; install it on its own.
          uv pip install "cua-som>=0.1.0,<0.2.0"
          uv pip install pytest

      - name: Cache HuggingFace models
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/huggingface
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-hf-models-v1
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-hf-models-
          # Large cache - models can be several GB each and are reused across runs

      - name: Record test start time
        run: echo "TEST_START_TIME=$(date +%s)" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        env:
          # Ensure HuggingFace uses consistent cache location
          HF_HOME: ~/.cache/huggingface

      - name: Test model with agent loop
        id: test_model
        timeout-minutes: 20
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          cd tests/agent_loop_testing
          uv run python agent_test.py --model "${{ matrix.model }}"
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
          HF_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HF_TOKEN }}
          CUA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.CUA_API_KEY }}

      - name: Calculate test duration and prepare message
        if: always()
        run: |
          TEST_END_TIME=$(date +%s)

          # Handle case where TEST_START_TIME might not be set
          if [ -z "$TEST_START_TIME" ]; then
            TEST_START_TIME=$TEST_END_TIME
          fi

          TEST_DURATION=$((TEST_END_TIME - TEST_START_TIME))

          # Convert seconds to minutes and seconds
          MINUTES=$((TEST_DURATION / 60))
          SECONDS=$((TEST_DURATION % 60))

          # Format duration
          if [ $MINUTES -gt 0 ]; then
            DURATION_STR="${MINUTES}m ${SECONDS}s"
          else
            DURATION_STR="${SECONDS}s"
          fi

          # Determine status icon based on test step outcome
          if [ "${{ steps.test_model.outcome }}" == "success" ]; then
            STATUS_ICON="✅"
            STATUS_TEXT="PASSED"
            SLACK_COLOR="#36a64f"
          else
            STATUS_ICON="❌"
            STATUS_TEXT="FAILED"
            SLACK_COLOR="#dc3545"
          fi

          # Prepare Slack message
          echo "TESTS_CONTENT<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "*Cua Model Test Results*" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "*Model:* ${{ matrix.model }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "*Status:* ${STATUS_ICON} ${STATUS_TEXT}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "*Duration:* ${DURATION_STR}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "*Run:* ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV

          # Set color based on outcome
          echo "SLACK_COLOR=${SLACK_COLOR}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

          # Save result to JSON file for summary
          mkdir -p test_summary
          MODEL_NAME="${{ matrix.model }}"
          # Sanitize model name for filename
          SAFE_MODEL_NAME=$(echo "$MODEL_NAME" | sed 's/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/_/g')

          # Determine pass status
          if [ "${{ steps.test_model.outcome }}" == "success" ]; then
            PASSED_VAL="true"
          else
            PASSED_VAL="false"
          fi

          # Create JSON file using printf to avoid YAML parsing issues
          printf '{\n  "model": "%s",\n  "status": "%s",\n  "status_icon": "%s",\n  "duration": "%s",\n  "duration_seconds": %d,\n  "passed": %s\n}' \
            "${MODEL_NAME}" "${STATUS_TEXT}" "${STATUS_ICON}" "${DURATION_STR}" "${TEST_DURATION}" "${PASSED_VAL}" \
            > "test_summary/${SAFE_MODEL_NAME}.json"
          # Expose safe model name for subsequent steps (artifact naming)
          echo "SAFE_MODEL_NAME=${SAFE_MODEL_NAME}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Upload test results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-results-${{ matrix.model }}
          path: |
            tests/agent_loop_testing/test_images/
            *.log
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload test summary data
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          # Unique, slash-free artifact name per matrix entry
          name: test-summary-${{ env.SAFE_MODEL_NAME }}
          path: test_summary/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 1

      - name: Set default Slack color
        if: always() && env.SLACK_COLOR == ''
        run: echo "SLACK_COLOR=#36a64f" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      # Individual model notifications disabled - only summary is sent
      # - name: Notify Slack with test results
      #   if: always()
      #   uses: rtCamp/action-slack-notify@33ca3be66c6f378fe1610fd1d5258632dbed5e58 # v2
      #   env:
      #     SLACK_WEBHOOK: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK }}
      #     SLACK_CHANNEL: ${{ vars.SLACK_CHANNEL }}
      #     SLACK_TITLE: Cua Model Test Update
      #     SLACK_COLOR: ${{ env.SLACK_COLOR }}
      #     SLACK_MESSAGE: |
      #       ${{ env.TESTS_CONTENT }}

  # Summary job that aggregates all model test results
  test-summary:
    if: ${{ always() }}
    needs: [resolve-models, test-all-models]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Download all test summary artifacts
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: test-summary-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: all_summaries

      - name: Generate and send summary
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          # Create directory if it doesn't exist
          mkdir -p all_summaries

          # Get list of models being tested in this run from the matrix
          # This helps filter out artifacts from previous runs when testing locally
          EXPECTED_MODELS="${{ join(fromJSON(needs.resolve-models.outputs.models), ' ') }}"

          # Aggregate all results
          PASSED_COUNT=0
          FAILED_COUNT=0
          TOTAL_DURATION=0
          SUMMARY_MESSAGE="*🚀 Model Summaries*\n\n"

          # Process each JSON file (find all JSON files recursively)
          # Save to temp file first to avoid subshell issues
          find all_summaries -name "*.json" -type f 2>/dev/null > /tmp/json_files.txt || true

          # Use associative array to deduplicate by model name
          declare -A processed_models

          while IFS= read -r json_file; do
            if [ -f "$json_file" ]; then
              MODEL=$(jq -r '.model' "$json_file")
              
              # Skip if we've already processed this model
              if [ "${processed_models[$MODEL]}" = "1" ]; then
                echo "Skipping duplicate model: $MODEL"
                continue
              fi
              
              # Filter: Only include models that are in the current matrix
              # This prevents including artifacts from previous workflow runs
              if [ -n "$EXPECTED_MODELS" ]; then
                if ! echo "$EXPECTED_MODELS" | grep -q "$MODEL"; then
                  echo "Skipping model from previous run: $MODEL"
                  continue
                fi
              fi
              
              # Mark as processed
              processed_models[$MODEL]="1"
              
              STATUS_ICON=$(jq -r '.status_icon' "$json_file")
              STATUS=$(jq -r '.status' "$json_file")
              DURATION=$(jq -r '.duration' "$json_file")
              DURATION_SEC=$(jq -r '.duration_seconds' "$json_file")
              PASSED=$(jq -r '.passed' "$json_file")
              
              # Add to summary as clean line format
              SUMMARY_MESSAGE="${SUMMARY_MESSAGE}${STATUS_ICON} ${STATUS} - \`${MODEL}\` - ${DURATION}\n"
              
              if [ "$PASSED" = "true" ]; then
                PASSED_COUNT=$((PASSED_COUNT + 1))
              else
                FAILED_COUNT=$((FAILED_COUNT + 1))
              fi
              TOTAL_DURATION=$((TOTAL_DURATION + DURATION_SEC))
            fi
          done < /tmp/json_files.txt

          # Check if we found any results
          TOTAL_COUNT=$((PASSED_COUNT + FAILED_COUNT))
          if [ $TOTAL_COUNT -eq 0 ]; then
            SUMMARY_MESSAGE="${SUMMARY_MESSAGE}⚠️ No test results found (workflow may have been canceled)\n"
            SLACK_COLOR="#ffa500"
          else
            # Add summary stats
            SUMMARY_MESSAGE="${SUMMARY_MESSAGE}\n*Results:* ${PASSED_COUNT} passed, ${FAILED_COUNT} failed out of ${TOTAL_COUNT} models\n"
            
            # Calculate total duration
            TOTAL_MIN=$((TOTAL_DURATION / 60))
            TOTAL_SEC=$((TOTAL_DURATION % 60))
            if [ $TOTAL_MIN -gt 0 ]; then
              TOTAL_DURATION_STR="${TOTAL_MIN}m ${TOTAL_SEC}s"
            else
              TOTAL_DURATION_STR="${TOTAL_SEC}s"
            fi
            SUMMARY_MESSAGE="${SUMMARY_MESSAGE}*Total Duration:* ${TOTAL_DURATION_STR}\n"
            
            # Determine color based on results
            if [ $FAILED_COUNT -eq 0 ]; then
              SLACK_COLOR="#36a64f"
            elif [ $PASSED_COUNT -eq 0 ]; then
              SLACK_COLOR="#dc3545"
            else
              SLACK_COLOR="#ffa500"
            fi
          fi

          SUMMARY_MESSAGE="${SUMMARY_MESSAGE}*Run:* ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}"

          # Export for use in next step
          echo "SUMMARY_MESSAGE<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo -e "${SUMMARY_MESSAGE}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "SLACK_COLOR=${SLACK_COLOR}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Send summary to Slack
        if: always()
        uses: rtCamp/action-slack-notify@33ca3be66c6f378fe1610fd1d5258632dbed5e58 # v2
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK }}
          SLACK_CHANNEL: ${{ vars.SLACK_CHANNEL }}
          SLACK_TITLE: Cua Models Test Summary
          SLACK_COLOR: ${{ env.SLACK_COLOR }}
          SLACK_MESSAGE: |
            ${{ env.SUMMARY_MESSAGE }}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# CI setup for the cua SDK e2e suite (Linux runners; also fine on a Mac with
# the brief's toolchain). Builds everything the lanes need:
#
#   the cua SDK (release cdylib, staged for Python and Node), the cua CLI and
#   cua-test-fixtures (debug), the TS package and its wasm browser build,
#   Playwright's headless Chromium (into $CUA_E2E_PLAYWRIGHT_DIR), gVisor.
#   --images  linux (with a freshly built cua-spacesd) and the
#             two plain images, rootfs form, host arch
#   --disks   the VM disks of linux and plain/ubuntu-server into
#             ~/.cache/cua-images-e2e, plus QEMU and firmware
set -euo pipefail
HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO="$(cd "$HERE/../../.." && pwd)"
IMAGES=0; DISKS=0
for a in "$@"; do
    case "$a" in --images) IMAGES=1 ;; --disks) DISKS=1 ;; *) echo "unknown $a" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
done
arch="$(uname -m)"; case "$arch" in arm64|aarch64) harch=arm64 ;; *) harch=amd64 ;; esac
step() { echo "::group::$*"; }
end() { echo "::endgroup::"; }

if [ "$(uname -s)" = Linux ]; then
    step "system packages, gVisor"
    sudo apt-get update -qq
    pkgs="genisoimage"
    [ "$DISKS" = 1 ] && pkgs="$pkgs qemu-utils qemu-system-x86 qemu-system-arm ovmf qemu-efi-aarch64"
    # shellcheck disable=SC2086
    sudo apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends $pkgs
    [ -e /dev/kvm ] && sudo chmod 666 /dev/kvm || true
    "$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../../.." && pwd)/scripts/images/install-gvisor.sh"
    docker info --format '{{json .Runtimes}}'
    end
fi

step "cua SDK, CLI, fixtures"
cd "$REPO/libs/cua"
cargo build --locked -p cua-cli -p cua-sdk
scripts/build-test-fixtures.sh
cargo build --locked --release -p cua-sdk
end

step "TypeScript package + browser (wasm) build"
cd "$REPO/libs/cua/typescript"
npm ci
node ../scripts/stage-uniffi-library.mjs --only=python,node
npm run build
if ! command -v wasm-pack >/dev/null; then
    curl -fsSL https://rustwasm.github.io/wasm-pack/installer/init.sh | sh -s -- -f
fi
command -v wasm-bindgen >/dev/null || cargo install --locked wasm-bindgen-cli --version 0.2.126
npm run build:browser
end

step "Playwright Chromium"
pw="${CUA_E2E_PLAYWRIGHT_DIR:-$REPO/tests/e2e/cua-sdk/.playwright}"
mkdir -p "$pw" && cd "$pw"
[ -f package.json ] || echo '{"type":"module"}' >package.json
npm i -s playwright@1
if [ "$(uname -s)" = Linux ]; then npx playwright install --with-deps chromium-headless-shell; else npx playwright install chromium-headless-shell; fi
end

if [ "$IMAGES" = 1 ]; then
    step "reference images (rootfs, $harch)"
    cd "$REPO/libs/images"
    linux/build-spacesd-linux.sh "$harch"
    ./build.sh linux
    ./build.sh plain/ubuntu-server
    ./build.sh plain/ubuntu-xfce-vnc
    end
fi

if [ "$DISKS" = 1 ]; then
    step "reference disks ($harch) -> ~/.cache/cua-images-e2e"
    cd "$REPO/libs/images"
    [ -x "linux/dist/$harch/cua-spacesd" ] || linux/build-spacesd-linux.sh "$harch"
    ./build.sh linux --tag e2e --outputs rootfs,disk --out "$HOME/.cache/cua-images-e2e"
    ./build.sh plain/ubuntu-server --tag e2e --outputs rootfs,disk --out "$HOME/.cache/cua-images-e2e"
    end
fi
echo "cua e2e setup done"

# Hidden docs preludes

A docs block tagged `prelude="<name>[,<name>]"` runs with setup the reader
does not see (`tests/e2e/cua-sdk/python/test_docs_blocks.py`):

| Name | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `fakefleet` | `CUA_FLEET_BASE_URL` and `FLEETS_TOKEN` point at the fake Fleet API of `cua-test-fixtures`, so cloud examples run unchanged on pull requests. Every claim's `env` service reaches a MockServer cua-spacesd, the signed-URL API is implemented, and image manifests come from the fixtures' registry mirror (`CUA_REGISTRY_MIRRORS`), so nothing touches the network. |
| `spacesd` | `CUA_DOCS_SPACESD_URL` and `CUA_DOCS_SPACESD_TOKEN` name the fixtures' MockServer cua-spacesd. |
| `space-url` | The direct-Space address and token a page shows (`space-url.subst.json`) become the fixtures' cua-spacesd server core, confined to temp directories. |
| `space` | `space.py` / `space.ts` define `spaces` and a registered direct `space` on that core, for excerpts that continue a page; teleport reads the fixtures' synthetic Firefox profile, never the host's. |

`team-pool` creates the dedicated pool a page claims from, named by
`CUA_POOL_NAME`; `team-pool.subst.json` puts that name where the page shows
`my-team-desktop`.

In the nightly `fleet` lane the same blocks run against live Fleet with the
same preludes, minus `fakefleet`, `spacesd` and the Space ones, and with
per-run `cua-e2e-*` pool names; the pool is deleted afterwards.

`<name>.subst.json` maps a literal the page shows to the environment variable
holding the fixture's value. A file `<name>.py` or `<name>.ts` here is prepended to the program of a
Python or TypeScript block that names it. A Python program may use top-level `await` (it then runs in one event loop,
like `python -m asyncio`). Keep preludes small: they are code the page does
not show.

Code preludes (each file says what it sets up): `local-cleanup` (deletes the
local sandboxes a block leaves; use it on every container-lane block that
does not delete its own), `image`, `image-desktop`, `images-dev`, `sb-web`,
`sb-web-local`, `sb-linux-local`, `sb-mcp-local`, `pool-name`, `pool-vars`,
`pool-applied`, `cua-embedded` and `spacesd-3211`.

name: "CI: cua-sandbox action lint"

# The light checks of the cua-sandbox action: shellcheck on its script and
# actionlint on every YAML example in its docs pages (against action.yml).
# Docs-only edits run this, never the image doctor
# (ci-cua-sandbox-doctor.yml).

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - ".github/actions/cua-sandbox/**"
      - "docs/content/docs/cua-sdk/guides/test-in-ci.mdx"
      - "docs/content/docs/cua-driver/guides/test-in-a-sandbox.mdx"
      - "docs/content/docs/start-here/run-in-github-actions.mdx"
      - ".github/workflows/ci-cua-sandbox-action.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  # Cua programs and packages run here never send usage telemetry.
  CUA_TELEMETRY: "0"
  DO_NOT_TRACK: "1"

jobs:
  lint:
    name: shellcheck and docs actionlint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
      - name: shellcheck
        run: shellcheck .github/actions/cua-sandbox/cua-sandbox.sh
      - name: actionlint on the docs examples
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          VERSION=1.7.12
          curl -fsSL -o actionlint.tgz \
            "https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/releases/download/v${VERSION}/actionlint_${VERSION}_linux_amd64.tar.gz"
          tar xzf actionlint.tgz actionlint
          python3 .github/actions/cua-sandbox/lint-docs-yaml.py ./actionlint

name: "CI: Driver Linux dependency bootstrap"

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - ".github/workflows/cd-rust-cua-driver.yml"
      - ".github/workflows/ci-driver-linux-bootstrap.yml"
      - ".github/scripts/tests/test_driver_linux_bootstrap.py"

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  # Cua programs and packages run here never send usage telemetry.
  CUA_TELEMETRY: "0"
  DO_NOT_TRACK: "1"

concurrency:
  group: ci-driver-linux-bootstrap-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  bootstrap:
    name: Debian 11 bootstrap (${{ matrix.arch }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - arch: amd64
            runner: ubuntu-latest
          - arch: arm64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
      - name: Check snapshot and authentication contract
        run: python3 .github/scripts/tests/test_driver_linux_bootstrap.py
      - name: Extract the exact release-workflow bootstrap
        run: |
          python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/bootstrap-parser"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/bootstrap-parser/bin/pip" install PyYAML==6.0.3
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/bootstrap-parser/bin/python" - <<'PY'
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          import yaml

          workflow = yaml.safe_load(Path('.github/workflows/cd-rust-cua-driver.yml').read_text())
          job = workflow['jobs']['build-linux']
          assert job['container']['image'] == 'debian:11'
          steps = [step for step in job['steps'] if step.get('name') == 'Install base tooling (container is bare)']
          assert len(steps) == 1
          Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'], 'driver-bootstrap.sh').write_text('set -eu\n' + steps[0]['run'])
          PY
      - name: Install dependencies on the native architecture
        env:
          EXPECTED_ARCH: ${{ matrix.arch }}
        run: |
          docker pull debian:11
          docker image inspect debian:11 --format '{{json .RepoDigests}}'
          docker run --rm -i -e EXPECTED_ARCH debian:11 sh -e -c '
            test "$(dpkg --print-architecture)" = "$EXPECTED_ARCH"
            uname -m
            sh -e -s
            dpkg-query -W git ca-certificates curl python3 build-essential pkg-config libx11-dev libxi-dev libxtst-dev libxext-dev libwayland-dev libxkbcommon-dev
            ldd --version
            test "$(getconf GNU_LIBC_VERSION)" = "glibc 2.31"
          ' < "$RUNNER_TEMP/driver-bootstrap.sh"

name: "CI: Installers"

# install.sh / install.ps1 (scripts/install), the release manifest generator
# and the macOS .pkg, exercised against a locally served fake release. Nothing
# here installs onto the runner outside temp dirs, except the Linux container
# smoke, which installs into a throwaway container.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "scripts/install/**"
      - "apps/cua-spaces/scripts/build-pkg.sh"
      - "apps/cua-spaces/scripts/prepare-cli-sidecar.sh"
      - "apps/cua-spaces/src-tauri/installer/**"
      - "apps/cua-spaces/tests/installer/**"
      - ".github/workflows/ci-installers.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-installers-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  # Cua programs and packages run here never send usage telemetry.
  CUA_TELEMETRY: "0"
  DO_NOT_TRACK: "1"

jobs:
  lint:
    name: shellcheck + shfmt + manifest unit tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: shellcheck
        run: |
          docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/w:ro" koalaman/shellcheck:stable -s sh \
            /w/scripts/install/install.sh /w/scripts/install/tests/run.sh /w/scripts/install/tests/docker-pester.sh \
            /w/apps/cua-spaces/scripts/build-pkg.sh /w/apps/cua-spaces/scripts/prepare-cli-sidecar.sh \
            /w/apps/cua-spaces/src-tauri/installer/macos-pkg/postinstall /w/apps/cua-spaces/tests/installer/pkg.test.sh
      - name: shfmt
        run: |
          docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/w:ro" mvdan/shfmt:v3 -d \
            /w/scripts/install/install.sh /w/scripts/install/tests/run.sh \
            /w/apps/cua-spaces/scripts/build-pkg.sh /w/apps/cua-spaces/scripts/prepare-cli-sidecar.sh \
            /w/apps/cua-spaces/src-tauri/installer/macos-pkg/postinstall /w/apps/cua-spaces/tests/installer/pkg.test.sh
      - name: release_manifest.py unit tests
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/install/tests -v

  installer-smoke-linux:
    name: installer smoke (Linux containers)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        image: ["debian:12", "ubuntu:24.04", "alpine:3"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: install.sh test suite (fake release on a local HTTP server)
        run: |
          docker run --rm -v "$PWD/scripts/install:/w:ro" "${{ matrix.image }}" sh -c '
            set -e
            if command -v apk >/dev/null; then apk add -q python3 curl; adduser -D u
            else apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq python3 curl ca-certificates bsdutils >/dev/null; useradd -m u; fi
            echo "--- as root (dash/ash, deb path dry run)"; sh /w/tests/run.sh
            echo "--- as a user"; su u -c "sh /w/tests/run.sh"
          '
      - name: install.sh --yes --no-onboarding against a served release dir
        run: |
          docker run --rm -v "$PWD/scripts/install:/w:ro" "${{ matrix.image }}" sh -c '
            set -e
            if command -v apk >/dev/null; then apk add -q python3 curl; else apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq python3 curl ca-certificates >/dev/null; fi
            mkdir -p /rel/cua-install-latest /stage
            printf "#!/bin/sh\necho cua 0.0.1\n" > /stage/cua && chmod +x /stage/cua
            arch=x64; case "$(uname -m)" in aarch64|arm64) arch=arm64;; esac
            tar -czf /rel/cua-install-latest/cua-cli-0.0.1-linux-$arch.tar.gz -C /stage cua
            printf "#!/bin/sh\necho spaces\n" > /rel/cua-install-latest/cua-spaces-0.0.1-linux-$arch.AppImage
            python3 /w/release_manifest.py --component cli --version 0.0.1 --dir /rel/cua-install-latest --out /tmp/cli.json
            python3 /w/release_manifest.py --component app --version 0.0.1 --dir /rel/cua-install-latest \
              --merge /tmp/cli.json --out /rel/cua-install-latest/release-artifacts.json
            (cd /rel && python3 -m http.server 8765 >/dev/null 2>&1 &)
            sleep 1
            CUA_INSTALL_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8765 sh /w/install.sh --yes --no-onboarding --mode client
            /usr/local/bin/cua --version
            test -x /usr/local/bin/cua-spaces
            grep -qx client "$HOME/.cua/spaces-install-mode"
          '

  installer-smoke-macos:
    name: installer smoke (macOS, temp prefix + dmg mount + pkg)
    runs-on: macos-14
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: install.sh test suite (includes the .dmg mount into --prefix)
        run: sh scripts/install/tests/run.sh
      - name: .pkg build + expand + postinstall against a temp volume
        run: sh apps/cua-spaces/tests/installer/pkg.test.sh

  installer-smoke-windows:
    name: installer smoke (Windows, install.ps1)
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Pester
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Install-Module Pester -Force -Scope CurrentUser -MinimumVersion 5.5
          $r = Invoke-Pester scripts/install/tests -Output Detailed -PassThru
          if ($r.FailedCount -gt 0) { exit 1 }
      - name: install.ps1 -DryRun against a local fake release
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $rel = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'rel'
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $rel | Out-Null
          Set-Content (Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'cua.exe') 'fake'
          Compress-Archive (Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'cua.exe') (Join-Path $rel 'cua-cli-0.0.1-windows-x64.zip')
          Set-Content (Join-Path $rel 'cua-spaces-0.0.1-windows-x64.msi') 'msi'
          python scripts/install/release_manifest.py --component cli --version 0.0.1 --dir $rel --out "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/cli.json"
          python scripts/install/release_manifest.py --component app --version 0.0.1 --dir $rel --merge "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/cli.json" --out (Join-Path $rel 'release-artifacts.json')
          $env:CUA_INSTALL_MANIFEST_URL = 'file:///' + ((Join-Path $rel 'release-artifacts.json') -replace '\\', '/')
          $env:CUA_INSTALL_ARCH = 'AMD64'
          ./scripts/install/install.ps1 -DryRun -Yes -Mode host
          ./scripts/install/install.ps1 -CliOnly -Yes -NoOnboarding -Prefix (Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'prefix')
          if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'prefix/bin/cua.exe'))) { throw 'cua.exe was not installed' }

name: "CI: Cua Driver installer compatibility"

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      versions:
        description: "Comma-separated released versions; blank tests the newest two"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ""
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 9 * * 1"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      versions:
        description: "Comma-separated released versions; blank tests the newest two"
        required: false
        default: ""

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

# No concurrency group. In a reusable call the group would belong to the
# caller's run, and "CI: Release metadata" starts several runs for one pull
# request at once (opened, labeled, edited, synchronize). Cancelling the older
# ones made each superseded run's `validate` see `cancelled` and fail, and that
# failed `validate` check on the head commit blocked the merge even after the
# newest run passed. Every run now finishes. For most pull requests the scope
# job skips the installer matrix, so duplicates cost little.

jobs:
  scope:
    name: Resolve installer compatibility scope
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      should_run: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.should_run }}
      versions: ${{ steps.versions.outputs.versions }}
    steps:
      - name: Decide whether installer compatibility is affected
        id: scope
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          SHOULD_RUN=true
          if [[ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" == "pull_request" ]]; then
            CHANGED_FILES=$(gh api --paginate \
              "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/pulls/$PR_NUMBER/files?per_page=100" \
              --jq '.[].filename')
            if ! grep -Eq \
              '^(\.github/release-state/cua-driver-rs-(published-version|withdrawn-versions)|\.github/scripts/verify_cua_driver_release_archives\.py|\.github/scripts/tests/test_verify_cua_driver_release_archives\.py|\.github/workflows/(cd-rust-cua-driver|ci-cua-driver-installer-compat)\.yml|libs/cua-driver/scripts/(_install-common|_install-rust|install)\.sh|libs/cua-driver/scripts/(_install-common\.psm1|install\.ps1)|release-please-config\.json)$' \
              <<< "$CHANGED_FILES"; then
              SHOULD_RUN=false
            fi
          fi
          echo "should_run=$SHOULD_RUN" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Read withdrawn versions
        if: steps.scope.outputs.should_run == 'true'
        uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
        with:
          sparse-checkout: .github/release-state
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Resolve released versions
        id: versions
        if: steps.scope.outputs.should_run == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          INPUT_VERSIONS: ${{ inputs.versions }}
          # The installers download from trycua/cua releases, so the versions
          # under test come from there too, on this repository and on forks
          # such as cua-staging whose own releases are unrelated.
          RELEASE_REPOSITORY: trycua/cua
        run: |
          if [[ -n "$INPUT_VERSIONS" ]]; then
            VERSIONS=$(tr ', ' '\n' <<< "$INPUT_VERSIONS" |
              sed '/^$/d' |
              jq -Rsc 'split("\n") | map(select(length > 0)) | unique')
          else
            WITHDRAWN=$(sed -e 's/#.*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]//g' -e '/^$/d' \
              .github/release-state/cua-driver-rs-withdrawn-versions |
              jq -Rsc 'split("\n") | map(select(length > 0))')
            VERSIONS=$(gh api --paginate --slurp \
              "repos/$RELEASE_REPOSITORY/releases?per_page=100" |
              jq -c --argjson withdrawn "$WITHDRAWN" '[
                .[][]
                | select(.draft == false)
                | .tag_name
                | select(startswith("cua-driver-rs-v"))
                | ltrimstr("cua-driver-rs-v")
                | select(. as $v | $withdrawn | index($v) | not)
              ][0:2]')
          fi
          echo "Withdrawn versions skipped: $(sed -e 's/#.*//' -e '/^[[:space:]]*$/d' .github/release-state/cua-driver-rs-withdrawn-versions | tr -d ' ' | paste -sd, -)"

          if [[ "$(jq 'length' <<< "$VERSIONS")" -eq 0 ]]; then
            echo "No published Cua Driver release was found" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          while IFS= read -r version; do
            if ! [[ "$version" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
              echo "Invalid released version: $version" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
          done < <(jq -r '.[]' <<< "$VERSIONS")
          echo "versions=$VERSIONS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Testing released versions: $(jq -r 'join(", ")' <<< "$VERSIONS")"

  install:
    name: "${{ matrix.os }} / v${{ matrix.version }}"
    needs: scope
    if: needs.scope.outputs.should_run == 'true'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-26, windows-latest]
        version: ${{ fromJSON(needs.scope.outputs.versions) }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      CUA_DRIVER_RS_VERSION: ${{ matrix.version }}
      CUA_DRIVER_RS_KEEP_VERSIONS: "0"
      CUA_DRIVER_RS_TELEMETRY_ENABLED: "false"
      CUA_TELEMETRY_ENABLED: "false"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Linux runtime libraries
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
            libx11-6 libxi6 libxtst6 libxext6 libwayland-client0 libxkbcommon0

      - name: Run the current macOS/Linux installer against the release
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        env:
          CUA_DRIVER_RS_HOME: ${{ runner.temp }}/cua-driver-home
          CUA_DRIVER_RS_INSTALL_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/cua-driver-bin
          CUA_DRIVER_RS_NO_MODIFY_PATH: "1"
        run: |
          bash libs/cua-driver/scripts/install.sh --no-modify-path
          INSTALLED="$CUA_DRIVER_RS_INSTALL_DIR/cua-driver"
          test -x "$INSTALLED"
          VERSION_OUTPUT=$("$INSTALLED" --version)
          echo "$VERSION_OUTPUT"
          grep -Fq "${CUA_DRIVER_RS_VERSION}" <<< "$VERSION_OUTPUT"
          if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" == "macOS" ]]; then
            test -x /Applications/CuaDriver.app/Contents/MacOS/cua-driver
            /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c Print:CFBundleIdentifier \
              /Applications/CuaDriver.app/Contents/Info.plist |
              grep -Fx com.trycua.driver
          fi

      - name: Run the current Windows installer against the release
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $root = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP "cua-driver-installer"
          $env:CUA_DRIVER_RS_HOME = Join-Path $root "home"
          $env:CUA_DRIVER_RS_INSTALL_DIR = Join-Path $root "bin"
          & ./libs/cua-driver/scripts/install.ps1 `
            -Release $env:CUA_DRIVER_RS_VERSION `
            -NoAutoStart `
            -NoPathUpdate
          $binary = Join-Path $env:CUA_DRIVER_RS_INSTALL_DIR "cua-driver.exe"
          if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $binary)) {
            throw "installer did not create $binary"
          }
          $versionOutput = & $binary --version
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "installed binary exited with $LASTEXITCODE"
          }
          Write-Host $versionOutput
          if ($versionOutput -notmatch [regex]::Escape($env:CUA_DRIVER_RS_VERSION)) {
            throw "installed binary version does not match $env:CUA_DRIVER_RS_VERSION"
          }

  installer-compatibility:
    name: Installer compatibility summary
    needs: [scope, install]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Report result
        run: |
          echo "scope:   ${{ needs.scope.result }}"
          echo "install: ${{ needs.install.result }}"
          echo "selected: ${{ needs.scope.outputs.should_run }}"
          if [[ "${{ needs.scope.result }}" != "success" ]]; then
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ "${{ needs.scope.outputs.should_run }}" == "true" &&
                "${{ needs.install.result }}" != "success" ]]; then
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ "${{ needs.scope.outputs.should_run }}" != "true" ]]; then
            echo "Installer compatibility is unaffected by this pull request."
          fi

name: "CD: cua SDK"

# Builds and publishes the cua SDK for tag `cua-sdk-v<version>`:
#   - native libcua_sdk (+ the copy-based N-API runtime) per platform,
#   - platform wheels of PyPI `cua` (linux x86_64/aarch64 with the
#     glibc 2.31 floor from debian:11, macOS arm64/x86_64, Windows x64/arm64),
#   - `@trycua/cua` + six optional native npm packages (+ the browser build),
#   - `CuaSDKFFI.xcframework.zip` for the Swift `.binaryTarget`,
#   - the `cua` CLI binaries, plus standalone `cua-cli-<version>-<platform>`
#     archives, checksums.txt and release-artifacts.json for install.sh /
#     install.ps1 (also mirrored to the rolling `cua-install-latest` release).
# Mirrors cd-rust-cua-driver.yml / cd-py-cua-driver.yml.
#
# Signing (required whenever the run publishes; refuses to publish unsigned):
#   - macOS `cua`, libcua_sdk.dylib and the N-API runtime: Developer ID
#     Application + hardened runtime, notarized (secrets APPLICATION_CERT_BASE64,
#     CERT_PASSWORD, DEVELOPER_NAME, TEAM_ID, APPLE_ID, APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD).
#   - Windows cua.exe, cua_sdk.dll and the N-API runtime: Authenticode through
#     Azure Artifact Signing (environment cua-driver-release-signing, vars
#     AZURE_*), the same identity as the Cua Driver release.
#   - Every release asset gets a keyless Sigstore (cosign) bundle, which
#     install.sh / install.ps1 verify when cosign is installed.
# Release Please creates the release as a draft; the publish job fills it and
# publishes it before the rolling cua-install-latest feed moves. A hand-pushed
# tag with no release gets a new draft here.
#
# Canonical vs staging: only trycua/cua publishes to PyPI and npm and fails
# closed on missing signing secrets. Any other repository (trycua/cua-staging)
# runs the same pipeline end to end but PyPI gets `twine check` (and TestPyPI
# when TEST_PYPI_TOKEN is set), npm gets `npm publish --dry-run`, a missing
# Apple/Azure secret gives unsigned binaries, and the GitHub release is a
# prerelease whose title and notes say so. The CLI's download URLs, the
# installers' default repository and their Sigstore identity derive from
# github.repository. A version with a suffix (X.Y.Z-rc.1) is a prerelease
# everywhere: npm dist-tag `next`, never GitHub "latest", and on trycua/cua
# it leaves the rolling installer feed alone.

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "cua-sdk-v*"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: "Version to build (without the cua-sdk-v prefix)"
        required: true
      publish:
        description: "Publish to PyPI/npm and attach to the GitHub release"
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  # Cua programs and packages run here never send usage telemetry.
  CUA_TELEMETRY: "0"
  DO_NOT_TRACK: "1"
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  # `cua host setup` downloads cua-spacesd from this repository's releases.
  CUA_RELEASE_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
  # Registries and the fail-closed signing gates are for trycua/cua only.
  CANONICAL: ${{ github.repository == 'trycua/cua' }}

jobs:
  version:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.v.outputs.version }}
      tag: ${{ steps.v.outputs.tag }}
      publish: ${{ steps.v.outputs.publish }}
      prerelease: ${{ steps.v.outputs.prerelease }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
      # The `cua` CLI bakes libs/cua-spacesd/VERSION and `cua host setup`
      # downloads that release: every job needs this one, so nothing builds
      # or publishes while the pinned cua-spacesd is unpublished (Cua Spaces
      # 0.3.0 shipped a CLI pinned to a draft).
      - name: Check the baked cua-spacesd release is published
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: .github/scripts/check_spacesd_published.sh "$CUA_RELEASE_REPOSITORY"
      - id: v
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [[ "$GITHUB_REF" == refs/tags/cua-sdk-v* ]]; then
            VERSION="${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/cua-sdk-v}"
            PUBLISH=true
          else
            VERSION="${{ inputs.version }}"
            PUBLISH="${{ inputs.publish }}"
          fi
          # Signed artifacts carry the workflow ref in their Sigstore
          # identity, and the installers accept only a release tag: publish
          # only from one (run the workflow from the tag to re-publish).
          if [[ "$PUBLISH" == true && "$GITHUB_REF" != "refs/tags/cua-sdk-v$VERSION" ]]; then
            echo "publishing needs the run's ref to be refs/tags/cua-sdk-v$VERSION (got $GITHUB_REF)" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! [[ "$VERSION" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+([-+][0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$ ]]; then
            echo "invalid version $VERSION" >&2; exit 1
          fi
          PRERELEASE=false
          if [[ "$VERSION" == *-* || "$CANONICAL" != true ]]; then PRERELEASE=true; fi
          {
            echo "version=$VERSION"
            echo "tag=cua-sdk-v$VERSION"
            echo "publish=$PUBLISH"
            echo "prerelease=$PRERELEASE"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  native:
    needs: version
    name: native ${{ matrix.label }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 90
    container: ${{ matrix.container }}
    # Holds the Azure Artifact Signing identity (Windows Authenticode).
    environment: cua-driver-release-signing
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    env:
      PUBLISH: ${{ needs.version.outputs.publish }}
      # A publishing run on trycua/cua never ships unsigned binaries.
      REQUIRE_SIGNING: ${{ needs.version.outputs.publish == 'true' && github.repository == 'trycua/cua' }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - { label: linux-x64-gnu, runner: ubuntu-latest, target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, container: "debian:11", lib: libcua_sdk.so, exe: cua }
          - { label: linux-arm64-gnu, runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm, target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, container: "debian:11", lib: libcua_sdk.so, exe: cua }
          - { label: darwin-arm64, runner: macos-26, target: aarch64-apple-darwin, container: "", lib: libcua_sdk.dylib, exe: cua }
          - { label: darwin-x64, runner: macos-26, target: x86_64-apple-darwin, container: "", lib: libcua_sdk.dylib, exe: cua }
          - { label: win32-x64-msvc, runner: windows-latest, target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, container: "", lib: cua_sdk.dll, exe: cua.exe }
          - { label: win32-arm64-msvc, runner: windows-11-arm, target: aarch64-pc-windows-msvc, container: "", lib: cua_sdk.dll, exe: cua.exe }
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    steps:
      - name: Install base tooling (debian:11 is bare)
        if: matrix.container != ''
        run: |
          # The live bullseye-security mirror now 404s: freeze indexes and
          # packages on snapshot.debian.org (same pin as cd-rust-cua-driver.yml;
          # the glibc 2.31 floor is unchanged). HTTP bootstraps ca-certificates;
          # APT still verifies Debian signatures and hashes.
          cat > /etc/apt/sources.list <<'EOF'
          deb [check-valid-until=no signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg] http://snapshot.debian.org/archive/debian/20260901T000000Z/ bullseye main
          deb [check-valid-until=no signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg] http://snapshot.debian.org/archive/debian/20260901T000000Z/ bullseye-updates main
          deb [check-valid-until=no signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg] http://snapshot.debian.org/archive/debian-security/20260901T000000Z/ bullseye-security main
          EOF
          rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources
          # snapshot.debian.org answers 504 under load; retry each fetch.
          echo 'Acquire::Retries "5";' > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/80-retries
          apt-get update
          apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates curl build-essential \
            pkg-config unzip python3 xz-utils cmake
          curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_22.x | bash -
          apt-get install -y nodejs
      - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
      - name: Install protoc
        uses: arduino/setup-protoc@c65c819552d16ad3c9b72d9dfd5ba5237b9c906b # v3.0.0
        with:
          version: "29.x"
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.97.1
        with:
          targets: ${{ matrix.target }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        if: matrix.container == ''
        with:
          node-version: "22"
      - name: Build libcua_sdk, the cua CLI and the N-API runtime
        working-directory: libs/cua
        env:
          # cua_sdk_version() and `cua --version` report the published version.
          CUA_SDK_RELEASE_VERSION: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
          # Windows native packages must load without the VC++ redistributable.
          RUSTFLAGS: ${{ contains(matrix.target, 'windows') && '-C target-feature=+crt-static' || '' }}
        run: |
          cargo build --locked --release -p cua-sdk -p cua-cli --target ${{ matrix.target }}
          npm --prefix typescript ci --ignore-scripts
          node scripts/build-node-runtime.mjs --target ${{ matrix.target }} \
            --output "native/${{ matrix.label }}/cua_node_runtime.node"
          mkdir -p "native/${{ matrix.label }}"
          cp "target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/${{ matrix.lib }}" "native/${{ matrix.label }}/"
          cp "target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/${{ matrix.exe }}" "native/${{ matrix.label }}/"
      - name: Developer ID sign and notarize (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        working-directory: libs/cua/native/${{ matrix.label }}
        env:
          APPLICATION_CERT_BASE64: ${{ secrets.APPLICATION_CERT_BASE64 }}
          CERT_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.CERT_PASSWORD }}
          DEVELOPER_NAME: ${{ secrets.DEVELOPER_NAME }}
          TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.TEAM_ID }}
          APPLE_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_ID }}
          APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "$APPLICATION_CERT_BASE64" ] || [ -z "$APPLE_ID" ]; then
            if [ "$REQUIRE_SIGNING" = true ]; then
              echo "::error::refusing to publish unsigned macOS binaries (Developer ID secrets missing)"
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "${{ matrix.label }}: UNSIGNED (no Developer ID signature, not notarized)" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/signing.txt"
            echo "::warning::Developer ID secrets are not set; the macOS binaries stay unsigned."
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "${{ matrix.label }}: Developer ID signed and notarized" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/signing.txt"
          kc="$RUNNER_TEMP/signing.keychain-db"
          kc_password="$(openssl rand -hex 16)"
          security create-keychain -p "$kc_password" "$kc"
          security set-keychain-settings -lut 3600 "$kc"
          security unlock-keychain -p "$kc_password" "$kc"
          echo "$APPLICATION_CERT_BASE64" | base64 --decode > "$RUNNER_TEMP/application.p12"
          security import "$RUNNER_TEMP/application.p12" -k "$kc" -P "$CERT_PASSWORD" -T /usr/bin/codesign
          rm "$RUNNER_TEMP/application.p12"
          security set-key-partition-list -S apple-tool:,apple:,codesign: -s -k "$kc_password" "$kc" > /dev/null
          security list-keychains -d user -s "$kc" login.keychain-db
          identity="Developer ID Application: $DEVELOPER_NAME ($TEAM_ID)"
          files=(cua libcua_sdk.dylib cua_node_runtime.node)
          for f in "${files[@]}"; do
            codesign --force --timestamp --options runtime --sign "$identity" --keychain "$kc" "$f"
            codesign --verify --strict --verbose=2 "$f"
          done
          # Bare Mach-O files cannot be stapled; notarization registers their
          # cdhashes with Apple, which Gatekeeper checks online.
          /usr/bin/ditto -c -k . "$RUNNER_TEMP/notarize.zip"
          xcrun notarytool submit "$RUNNER_TEMP/notarize.zip" \
            --apple-id "$APPLE_ID" --team-id "$TEAM_ID" --password "$APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD" \
            --wait --timeout 20m | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/notarize.log"
          grep -q "status: Accepted" "$RUNNER_TEMP/notarize.log"
      - name: Azure login for Artifact Signing (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows' && vars.AZURE_CLIENT_ID != ''
        uses: azure/login@f5d393ae46f8fde4be8b75f32e3fc50e654ad0ca # v3.0.1
        with:
          client-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          tenant-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          subscription-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}
      - name: Authenticode-sign the Windows binaries
        if: runner.os == 'Windows' && vars.AZURE_CLIENT_ID != ''
        uses: azure/artifact-signing-action@c7ab2a863ab5f9a846ddb8265964877ef296ee82 # v2.0.0
        with:
          endpoint: ${{ vars.AZURE_ARTIFACT_SIGNING_ENDPOINT }}
          signing-account-name: ${{ vars.AZURE_ARTIFACT_SIGNING_ACCOUNT_NAME }}
          certificate-profile-name: ${{ vars.AZURE_ARTIFACT_SIGNING_CERTIFICATE_PROFILE_NAME }}
          files: |
            ${{ github.workspace }}\libs\cua\native\${{ matrix.label }}\cua.exe
            ${{ github.workspace }}\libs\cua\native\${{ matrix.label }}\cua_sdk.dll
            ${{ github.workspace }}\libs\cua\native\${{ matrix.label }}\cua_node_runtime.node
          file-digest: SHA256
          timestamp-rfc3161: http://timestamp.acs.microsoft.com
          timestamp-digest: SHA256
          description: Cua
          description-url: https://cua.ai
      - name: Verify Authenticode signatures (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        working-directory: libs/cua/native/${{ matrix.label }}
        run: |
          $status = '${{ matrix.label }}: Authenticode signed (Azure Artifact Signing)'
          foreach ($file in @('cua.exe', 'cua_sdk.dll', 'cua_node_runtime.node')) {
            $signature = Get-AuthenticodeSignature -FilePath $file
            Write-Host "${file}: $($signature.Status)"
            if ($signature.Status -ne 'Valid') {
              if ($env:REQUIRE_SIGNING -eq 'true') { throw "refusing to publish: $file is not Authenticode-signed" }
              $status = '${{ matrix.label }}: UNSIGNED (no Authenticode; Azure Artifact Signing vars are not set)'
            }
          }
          Set-Content -Path "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/signing.txt" -Value $status
      - name: Signing status
        run: |
          [ -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/signing.txt" ] || echo "${{ matrix.label }}: no OS code signing on Linux (Sigstore bundle only)" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/signing.txt"
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/signing" && cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/signing.txt" "$RUNNER_TEMP/signing/${{ matrix.label }}.txt"
          cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/signing.txt"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: native-${{ matrix.label }}
          path: libs/cua/native/${{ matrix.label }}
          if-no-files-found: error
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: signing-${{ matrix.label }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/signing/${{ matrix.label }}.txt
          if-no-files-found: error

  wheels:
    needs: [version, native]
    name: wheel ${{ matrix.platform }}-${{ matrix.arch }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - { platform: linux, arch: x86_64, runner: ubuntu-latest, native: linux-x64-gnu, lib: libcua_sdk.so }
          - { platform: linux, arch: arm64, runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm, native: linux-arm64-gnu, lib: libcua_sdk.so }
          # One wheel per macOS arch: a universal2 wheel is over PyPI's 100 MB file limit.
          - { platform: darwin, arch: arm64, runner: macos-26, native: darwin-arm64, lib: libcua_sdk.dylib }
          - { platform: darwin, arch: x86_64, runner: macos-15-intel, native: darwin-x64, lib: libcua_sdk.dylib }
          - { platform: windows, arch: x86_64, runner: windows-latest, native: win32-x64-msvc, lib: cua_sdk.dll }
          - { platform: windows, arch: arm64, runner: windows-11-arm, native: win32-arm64-msvc, lib: cua_sdk.dll }
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@0b93645e9fea7318ecaed2b359559ac225c90a2b # v5.3.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: native-*
          path: native
      - name: Build the wheel
        working-directory: libs/cua/python
        run: |
          VERSION="${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}"
          sed -i.bak "s/^version = .*/version = \"$VERSION\"/" pyproject.toml && rm pyproject.toml.bak
          sed -i.bak "s/^__version__ = .*/__version__ = \"$VERSION\"/" src/cua/__init__.py && rm src/cua/__init__.py.bak
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip build hatchling
          DIR="../../../native/native-${{ matrix.native }}"
          EXE=cua; [ "${{ matrix.platform }}" = windows ] && EXE=cua.exe
          python build_wheel.py --library "$DIR/${{ matrix.lib }}" --cli "$DIR/$EXE" --platform ${{ matrix.platform }} --arch ${{ matrix.arch }}
      - name: Import the wheel
        working-directory: libs/cua/python
        run: |
          python -m pip install --force-reinstall dist/*.whl
          VERSION="${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}"
          cd / && python -c "import cua, sys; v = cua.cua_sdk_version(); print(v); cua.embedded(fleet_from_env=False); sys.exit(v != sys.argv[1])" "$VERSION"
          test "$(cua --version | tr -d '\r')" = "cua $VERSION"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: wheel-${{ matrix.platform }}-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: libs/cua/python/dist/*.whl
          if-no-files-found: error

  npm:
    needs: [version, native]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.97.1
        with:
          targets: wasm32-unknown-unknown
      - name: Install protoc
        uses: arduino/setup-protoc@c65c819552d16ad3c9b72d9dfd5ba5237b9c906b # v3.0.0
        with:
          version: "29.x"
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: native-*
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/downloads
      - name: Build the TypeScript package and the browser build
        working-directory: libs/cua
        env:
          CUA_SDK_RELEASE_VERSION: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          VERSION="${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}"
          npm --prefix typescript ci
          (cd typescript && npm version --no-git-tag-version "$VERSION" --allow-same-version)
          npm --prefix typescript run build
          cargo install wasm-bindgen-cli --version 0.2.126 --locked
          node scripts/build-wasm.mjs
      - name: Pack root and platform packages
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/native"
          for d in "$RUNNER_TEMP"/downloads/native-*; do
            cp -R "$d" "$RUNNER_TEMP/native/${d##*/native-}"
          done
          node libs/cua/scripts/build-npm-packages.mjs \
            --version "${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}" \
            --native-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/native" \
            --output-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/npm"
          ls -lh "$RUNNER_TEMP/npm"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: npm
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/npm/*.tgz
          if-no-files-found: error

  xcframework:
    needs: version
    runs-on: macos-26
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
      - name: Install protoc
        uses: arduino/setup-protoc@c65c819552d16ad3c9b72d9dfd5ba5237b9c906b # v3.0.0
        with:
          version: "29.x"
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.97.1
        with:
          targets: aarch64-apple-darwin,x86_64-apple-darwin,aarch64-apple-ios,aarch64-apple-ios-sim
      - name: Build CuaSDKFFI.xcframework.zip
        # `shell: bash` adds pipefail, so a failed build is not hidden by tee.
        shell: bash
        env:
          CUA_SDK_RELEASE_VERSION: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
          # Package.swift's minimums. Rust and the C dependencies (aws-lc,
          # SQLite) must target the same OS versions, or the iOS link misses
          # ___chkstk_darwin.
          MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: "12.0"
          IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: "15.0"
        run: libs/cua/swift/scripts/build-xcframework.sh --ios --zip | tee xcframework.log
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: xcframework
          path: |
            libs/cua/swift/build/CuaSDKFFI.xcframework.zip
            xcframework.log
          if-no-files-found: error

  publish:
    needs: [version, wheels, npm, xcframework, native]
    if: needs.version.outputs.publish == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: dist
      - uses: sigstore/cosign-installer@d58896d6a1865668819e1d91763c7751a165e159 # v3.9.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "24"
          registry-url: "https://registry.npmjs.org"
      # trycua/cua publishes; any other repository checks the wheels (and
      # uploads to TestPyPI when TEST_PYPI_TOKEN is set) without touching PyPI.
      - name: Publish wheels to PyPI (trycua/cua) or check them (staging)
        env:
          TWINE_USERNAME: __token__
          TWINE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.PYPI_TOKEN }}
          TEST_PYPI_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TEST_PYPI_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade twine
          python -m twine check --strict dist/wheel-*/*.whl
          if [ "$CANONICAL" = true ]; then
            python -m twine upload --skip-existing dist/wheel-*/*.whl
          elif [ -n "$TEST_PYPI_TOKEN" ]; then
            TWINE_PASSWORD="$TEST_PYPI_TOKEN" python -m twine upload --skip-existing \
              --repository-url https://test.pypi.org/legacy/ dist/wheel-*/*.whl
          else
            echo "::notice::$GITHUB_REPOSITORY is not trycua/cua: wheels checked, not uploaded to PyPI (DRY RUN)"
          fi
      - name: Publish npm packages, native first (trycua/cua) or dry-run them (staging)
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
          VERSION: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          # npm requires a dist-tag for a prerelease version; keep it off `latest`.
          flags=(--access public)
          [[ "$VERSION" == *-* ]] && flags+=(--tag next)
          if [ "$CANONICAL" = true ]; then
            flags+=(--provenance)
          else
            echo "::notice::$GITHUB_REPOSITORY is not trycua/cua: npm publish --dry-run (nothing reaches the registry)"
            flags+=(--dry-run)
          fi
          # Native packages first. A version already on the registry (a
          # re-run) is skipped; any other failure stops before the root
          # package can point at a missing native dependency.
          for package in dist/npm/trycua-cua-*-"$VERSION".tgz; do
            name="$(tar -xzOf "$package" package/package.json | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>console.log(JSON.parse(s).name))')"
            if [ "$CANONICAL" = true ] && npm view "$name@$VERSION" version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "$name@$VERSION is already published; skipping"
              continue
            fi
            npm publish "$package" "${flags[@]}"
          done
          if [ "$CANONICAL" = true ] && npm view "@trycua/cua@$VERSION" version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "@trycua/cua@$VERSION is already published; skipping"
            exit 0
          fi
          npm publish "dist/npm/trycua-cua-$VERSION.tgz" "${flags[@]}"
      - name: Attach artifacts to the release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
          PRERELEASE: ${{ needs.version.outputs.prerelease }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p release
          cp dist/wheel-*/*.whl dist/npm/*.tgz release/
          # upload-artifact keeps the paths below the files' common root.
          xcframework="$(find dist/xcframework -name CuaSDKFFI.xcframework.zip)"
          [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$xcframework" | grep -c .)" = 1 ] || { echo "expected one CuaSDKFFI.xcframework.zip, got: $xcframework" >&2; exit 1; }
          cp "$xcframework" release/
          for d in dist/native-*; do
            label="${d##*/native-}"
            tar -czf "release/cua-${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}-$label.tar.gz" -C "$d" .
          done
          # Standalone CLI archives for install.sh / install.ps1 (just `cua`).
          VERSION="${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}"
          for pair in linux-x64-gnu:linux-x64 linux-arm64-gnu:linux-arm64 darwin-arm64:darwin-arm64 \
            darwin-x64:darwin-x64 win32-x64-msvc:windows-x64 win32-arm64-msvc:windows-arm64; do
            label="${pair%%:*}" platform="${pair##*:}"
            d="dist/native-$label"
            if [ -f "$d/cua.exe" ]; then
              (cd "$d" && zip -q "$OLDPWD/release/cua-cli-$VERSION-$platform.zip" cua.exe)
            else
              chmod +x "$d/cua"
              tar -czf "release/cua-cli-$VERSION-$platform.tar.gz" -C "$d" cua
            fi
          done
          # release-artifacts.json: this CLI + the newest Spaces app from the
          # rolling cua-install-latest manifest (scripts/install/README.md).
          BASE="https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/download"
          gh release download cua-install-latest --pattern release-artifacts.json \
            --dir previous --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" 2>/dev/null || true
          # Keyless Sigstore bundles next to each asset; release_manifest.py
          # lists them and install.sh / install.ps1 verify them.
          for f in release/*; do
            cosign sign-blob --yes --bundle "$f.sigstore.json" "$f" >/dev/null
          done
          python3 scripts/install/release_manifest.py --component cli --version "$VERSION" \
            --dir release --base-url "$BASE/$TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --merge previous/release-artifacts.json --out release-artifacts.json
          cp release-artifacts.json release/
          (cd release && sha256sum -- * | sort > checksums.txt)
          # Release Please creates a draft with the tag; a hand-pushed tag
          # (a staging prerelease, a recovery) gets a new draft here.
          if ! gh release view "$TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            FLAGS=(--draft --verify-tag --title "cua SDK $VERSION" --notes "cua SDK $VERSION release assets.")
            [ "$PRERELEASE" = true ] && FLAGS+=(--prerelease)
            gh release create "$TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" "${FLAGS[@]}"
          fi
          gh release upload "$TAG" release/* --clobber --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
      # Release Please creates the release as a draft, whose assets are not
      # downloadable; publish it before the installer feed points at it.
      - name: Publish the release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
          VERSION: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
          PRERELEASE: ${{ needs.version.outputs.prerelease }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          flags=(--draft=false)
          # Staging builds and X.Y.Z-suffix versions are prereleases, never latest.
          [ "$PRERELEASE" = true ] && flags+=(--prerelease --latest=false)
          if [ "$CANONICAL" != true ] || grep -q UNSIGNED dist/signing-*/*.txt; then
            label="staging"; [ "$CANONICAL" = true ] && label="test"
            # Name the unsigned platforms: "UNSIGNED: windows-x64".
            unsigned="$(grep -h UNSIGNED dist/signing-*/*.txt | cut -d: -f1 | sort | paste -sd, - | sed 's/,/, /g')"
            [ -n "$unsigned" ] && label="$label, UNSIGNED: $unsigned"
            {
              echo "**$GITHUB_REPOSITORY prerelease ($label).** Built by cd-cua-sdk.yml at $GITHUB_REF ($GITHUB_SHA)."
              echo "Installs from $GITHUB_REPOSITORY, not trycua/cua."
              [ "$CANONICAL" = true ] || echo "PyPI and npm were dry runs: nothing was published to either registry."
              echo
              echo "Signing:"
              cat dist/signing-*/*.txt | sed 's/^/- /'
              echo
              echo "Every asset has a keyless Sigstore bundle (identity: https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/.github/workflows/cd-cua-sdk.yml@$GITHUB_REF)."
            } > notes.md
            flags+=(--title "cua SDK $VERSION ($label)" --notes-file notes.md)
          fi
          gh release edit "$TAG" "${flags[@]}" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
      # A prerelease on trycua/cua stays off the rolling feed; on any other
      # repository the feed is that repository's own and follows every release.
      - name: Update the rolling installer manifest (cua-install-latest)
        if: needs.version.outputs.prerelease != 'true' || github.repository != 'trycua/cua'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if ! gh release view cua-install-latest --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            # The Actions token may create a release only for an existing tag
            # (with --target, or for a new tag, the API answers 403). Push the tag
            # once by hand: git push origin <any commit>:refs/tags/cua-install-latest
            gh release create cua-install-latest --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --prerelease --verify-tag \
              --title "Cua installer feed (rolling)" \
              --notes "release-artifacts.json for install.sh / install.ps1. Always the newest cua CLI and Cua Spaces." || {
              echo "::error::could not create the rolling cua-install-latest release; push the cua-install-latest tag once by hand (any commit), then re-run this job"
              exit 1
            }
          fi
          # The installers default to this repository (download base and the
          # Sigstore identity they verify).
          python3 scripts/install/stamp_installers.py --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --out stamped
          gh release upload cua-install-latest release-artifacts.json \
            stamped/install.sh stamped/install.ps1 --clobber --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"

name: "CD: Image API"

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "image-api-v*"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: "Image API version without the v prefix"
        required: true
        type: string

concurrency:
  group: "image-api-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && format('image-api-v{0}', inputs.version) || github.ref_name }}"
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: write

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    env:
      MANUAL_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Determine version
        id: version
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ "${GITHUB_EVENT_NAME}" == "workflow_dispatch" ]]; then
            VERSION="${MANUAL_VERSION}"
          else
            VERSION="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#image-api-v}"
          fi
          if [[ ! "${VERSION}" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            echo "invalid Image API version: ${VERSION}" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          RELEASE_TAG="image-api-v${VERSION}"
          if [[ "${GITHUB_EVENT_NAME}" == "push" && "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" != "${RELEASE_TAG}" ]]; then
            echo "unexpected Image API tag: ${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/tags/${RELEASE_TAG}"; then
            echo "Image API release tag not found: ${RELEASE_TAG}" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          TAG_COMMIT="$(git rev-list -n 1 "${RELEASE_TAG}")"
          CHECKED_OUT_COMMIT="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          if [[ "${TAG_COMMIT}" != "${CHECKED_OUT_COMMIT}" ]]; then
            echo "Image API version ${VERSION} must run from ${RELEASE_TAG}" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          {
            echo "version=${VERSION}"
            echo "release_tag=${RELEASE_TAG}"
            echo "commit=${TAG_COMMIT}"
          } >>"${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

      - name: Install Flux CLI 2.9.4
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsSLo /tmp/flux.tar.gz \
            https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/releases/download/v2.9.4/flux_2.9.4_linux_amd64.tar.gz
          echo "c2c397a52930f52d2005c01d276116b059d062de379386d58e98115380a766a2  /tmp/flux.tar.gz" \
            | sha256sum -c -
          tar -xzf /tmp/flux.tar.gz -C /tmp flux
          sudo install -m 0755 /tmp/flux /usr/local/bin/flux
          flux version --client

      - name: Authenticate to GHCR
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "${{ github.token }}" | docker login ghcr.io \
            --username "${{ github.actor }}" \
            --password-stdin

      - name: Publish Image API artifact
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ steps.version.outputs.release_tag }}
          COMMIT: ${{ steps.version.outputs.commit }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Off trycua/cua (trycua/cua-staging) the artifact goes to a
          # separate -staging package, never the real one.
          PACKAGE=cua-image-api
          [ "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" = trycua/cua ] || PACKAGE=cua-image-api-staging
          ARTIFACT_DESTINATION="oci://ghcr.io/trycua/${PACKAGE}:v${VERSION}"
          ARTIFACT_REFERENCE="${ARTIFACT_DESTINATION#oci://}"
          set +e
          MANIFEST_OUTPUT="$(docker manifest inspect "${ARTIFACT_REFERENCE}" 2>&1)"
          MANIFEST_STATUS=$?
          set -e
          if [[ "${MANIFEST_STATUS}" -eq 0 ]]; then
            echo "Image API artifact already exists: ${ARTIFACT_DESTINATION}" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! grep -Eiq 'manifest unknown|no such manifest' <<<"${MANIFEST_OUTPUT}"; then
            echo "could not verify Image API artifact absence: ${ARTIFACT_DESTINATION}" >&2
            printf '%s\n' "${MANIFEST_OUTPUT}" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

name: "CD: cua-agent (PyPI)"

on:

  workflow_dispatch:

        required: true

  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: "Version to publish"
        required: true
        type: string

# Adding permissions at workflow level
permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  prepare:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.get-version.outputs.version }}
      sandbox_version: ${{ steps.update-deps.outputs.sandbox_version }}
      core_version: ${{ steps.update-deps.outputs.core_version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Ensure latest main branch
        run: |
          git fetch origin main
          git reset --hard origin/main
          echo "Current HEAD commit:"
          git log -1 --oneline

      - name: Determine version
        id: get-version
        run: |
          # Check inputs.version first (works for workflow_call regardless of event_name)
          if [ -n "${{ inputs.version }}" ]; then
            VERSION=${{ inputs.version }}
          elif [ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "push" ]; then
            # Extract version from tag (for package-specific tags)
            if [[ "${{ github.ref }}" =~ ^refs/tags/agent-v([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+) ]]; then
              VERSION=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}
            else
              echo "ERROR: Invalid tag format for agent"
              exit 1
            fi
          elif [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.version }}" ]; then
            VERSION=${{ github.event.inputs.version }}
          else
            echo "ERROR: No version found (inputs.version, event.inputs.version, and tag all empty)"
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Agent version: $VERSION"
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Update dependencies to latest versions
        id: update-deps
        run: |
          cd libs/python/agent

          # Install required package for PyPI API access
          pip install requests

          # Create a more robust Python script for PyPI version checking
          cat > get_latest_versions.py << 'EOF'
          import requests
          import json
          import sys

          def get_package_version(package_name, fallback="0.1.0"):
              try:
                  response = requests.get(f'https://pypi.org/pypi/{package_name}/json')
                  print(f"API Response Status for {package_name}: {response.status_code}", file=sys.stderr)
                  
                  if response.status_code != 200:
                      print(f"API request failed for {package_name}, using fallback version", file=sys.stderr)
                      return fallback
                  
                  data = json.loads(response.text)
                  
                  if 'info' not in data:
                      print(f"Missing 'info' key in API response for {package_name}, using fallback version", file=sys.stderr)
                      return fallback
                      
                  return data['info']['version']
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Error fetching version for {package_name}: {str(e)}", file=sys.stderr)
                  return fallback

          # Get latest versions
          print(get_package_version('cua-sandbox'))
          print(get_package_version('cua-core'))
          EOF

          # Execute the script to get the versions
          VERSIONS=($(python get_latest_versions.py))
          LATEST_SANDBOX=${VERSIONS[0]}
          LATEST_CORE=${VERSIONS[1]}

          echo "Latest cua-sandbox version: $LATEST_SANDBOX"
          echo "Latest cua-core version: $LATEST_CORE"

          # Output the versions for the next job
          echo "sandbox_version=$LATEST_SANDBOX" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "core_version=$LATEST_CORE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

          # Determine major version for version constraint
          SANDBOX_MAJOR=$(echo $LATEST_SANDBOX | cut -d. -f1)
          CORE_MAJOR=$(echo $LATEST_CORE | cut -d. -f1)

          NEXT_SANDBOX_MAJOR=$((SANDBOX_MAJOR + 1))
          NEXT_CORE_MAJOR=$((CORE_MAJOR + 1))

          # Update dependencies in pyproject.toml
          if [[ "$OSTYPE" == "darwin"* ]]; then
            # macOS version of sed needs an empty string for -i
            sed -i '' "s/\"cua-sandbox>=.*,<.*\"/\"cua-sandbox>=$LATEST_SANDBOX,<$NEXT_SANDBOX_MAJOR.0.0\"/" pyproject.toml
            sed -i '' "s/\"cua-core>=.*,<.*\"/\"cua-core>=$LATEST_CORE,<$NEXT_CORE_MAJOR.0.0\"/" pyproject.toml
          else
            # Linux version
            sed -i "s/\"cua-sandbox>=.*,<.*\"/\"cua-sandbox>=$LATEST_SANDBOX,<$NEXT_SANDBOX_MAJOR.0.0\"/" pyproject.toml
            sed -i "s/\"cua-core>=.*,<.*\"/\"cua-core>=$LATEST_CORE,<$NEXT_CORE_MAJOR.0.0\"/" pyproject.toml
          fi

          # Display the updated dependencies
          echo "Updated dependencies in pyproject.toml:"
          grep -E "cua-sandbox|cua-core" pyproject.toml

  publish:
    needs: prepare
    uses: ./.github/workflows/py-reusable-publish.yml
    with:
      package_name: "agent"
      package_dir: "libs/python/agent"
      version: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}
      base_package_name: "cua-agent"
    secrets:
      PYPI_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PYPI_TOKEN }}

  set-env-variables:
    needs: [prepare, publish]
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Set environment variables for use in other jobs
        run: |
          echo "SANDBOX_VERSION=${{ needs.prepare.outputs.sandbox_version }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "CORE_VERSION=${{ needs.prepare.outputs.core_version }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

  create-release:
    needs: [prepare, publish]
    uses: ./.github/workflows/release-github-reusable.yml
    with:
      tag_name: "agent-v${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}"
      release_name: "cua-agent v${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}"
      module_path: "libs/python/agent"
      body: |
        **Dependencies:** cua-sandbox ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.sandbox_version }}, cua-core ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.core_version }}

concurrency:
