jobs:
  candidate:
    name: MCP candidate (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 40
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-24.04, windows-latest]
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    env:
      EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG: "0"
      CUA_TELEMETRY_ENABLED: "false"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify exact source
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA"
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@4716b85f2fac3e324e64fa2810f6b5c3905760a5 # 1.97.1
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@9d47c6ad4b02e050fd481d890b2ea34778fd09d6 # v2
        with:
          workspaces: "libs/cua-driver/rust -> target"
          key: mcp-candidate
          save-if: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
      - name: Install Linux build dependencies
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
            clang pkg-config libdbus-1-dev libpipewire-0.3-dev libspa-0.2-dev \
            libei-dev libxkbcommon-dev libx11-dev libxi-dev libxtst-dev libxext-dev
      - name: Run envelope receiver and service tests
        working-directory: libs/cua-driver/rust
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo test -p cua-driver --bin cua-driver mcp_envelope --locked
          cargo test -p cua-driver --bin cua-driver driver_service_http --locked
          cargo test -p cua-driver-sdk remote_receiver::tests --locked
      - name: Build disposable-test binaries
        working-directory: libs/cua-driver/rust
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" == Linux ]]; then
            cargo build --locked -p cua-driver -p cursor-theme-cli --features cua-driver/portal-input
          else
            cargo build --locked -p cua-driver -p cursor-theme-cli -p cua-driver-uia
          fi
      - name: Bundle exact binaries and provenance
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import hashlib
          import json
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          import subprocess
          import tarfile

          source = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
          assert source == os.environ["EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA"]
          assert not subprocess.check_output(["git", "status", "--porcelain"], text=True).strip()
          windows = os.environ["RUNNER_OS"] == "Windows"
          names = ["cua-driver", "cua-cursor-theme"] + (["cua-driver-uia"] if windows else [])
          binaries = [Path("libs/cua-driver/rust/target/debug") / (name + (".exe" if windows else "")) for name in names]
          assert all(path.is_file() and path.stat().st_size > 0 for path in binaries)
          bundle = Path("mcp-candidate")
          bundle.mkdir()
          metadata = {
              "source_sha": source,
              "runner_os": os.environ["RUNNER_OS"],
              "profile": "dev, debug=0",
              "features": ["cua-driver/portal-input"] if not windows else [],
              "rustc": subprocess.check_output(["rustc", "--version"], text=True).strip(),
              "version": subprocess.check_output([str(binaries[0].resolve()), "--version"], text=True).strip(),
              "files": {path.name: hashlib.file_digest(path.open("rb"), "sha256").hexdigest() for path in binaries},
              "qualification": "Test-only unsigned candidate; not a release or image qualification.",
          }
          provenance = bundle / "provenance.json"
          provenance.write_text(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2) + "\n")
          with tarfile.open(bundle / "candidate.tar.gz", "w:gz") as archive:
              for path in binaries:
                  archive.add(path, arcname=path.name)
              archive.add(provenance, arcname=provenance.name)
          print(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2))
          PY
      - name: Upload candidate for separately authorized tests
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@65c4c4a1ddee5b72f698fdd19549f0f0fb45cf08 # v4
        with:
          name: driver-mcp-candidate-${{ runner.os }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
          path: |
            mcp-candidate/candidate.tar.gz
            mcp-candidate/provenance.json

jobs:
  rust:
    name: rust (${{ matrix.os }})

    timeout-minutes: 60
    strategy:

      matrix:

      run:

        with:

          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.97.1
        with:
          components: clippy, rustfmt
          targets: wasm32-unknown-unknown
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@9d47c6ad4b02e050fd481d890b2ea34778fd09d6 # v2
        with:
          workspaces: libs/cua
          key: cua-sdk

        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: cargo fmt -p cua-sdk -p cua-daemon -p cua-cli -p cua-bindgen -p cua-spacesd-client -p cua-media-protocol -p cua-media-transport -p cua-media-codec -p cua-media-client -p cua-viewer -p cua-logging -p cua-teleport -p cua-teleport-bundle -p cua-chromium-storage -p cua-spaces-ext -p cua-spaces-ffi -p cua-spaces-cli -- --check
      - name: Clippy (native)
        run: >
          cargo clippy --locked -p cua-sdk -p cua-daemon -p cua-cli -p cua-bindgen -p cua-spacesd-client
          -p cua-media-protocol -p cua-media-transport -p cua-media-client -p cua-viewer -p cua-logging
          -p cua-teleport -p cua-teleport-bundle -p cua-chromium-storage -p cua-volume
          -p cua-spaces-ext -p cua-spaces-ffi -p cua-spaces-cli
          --all-targets --features cua-daemon/test-fixtures,cua-media-client/media-decode -- -D warnings
      - name: Clippy (browser API, host metadata build)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: cargo clippy --locked -p cua-sdk --no-default-features --features web -- -D warnings
      - name: Build (wasm32)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: cargo build --locked -p cua-sdk --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features
      - name: Test Spaces discovery and post-create directory failures
        run: cargo test --locked -p cua-spaces --test relay --test cloud_discovery -- --test-threads=4
      - name: Test (embedded, daemon over UDS and loopback, CLI, Cua Spaces extensions)
        run: >
          cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast -p cua-sdk -p cua-daemon -p cua-cli -p cua-spacesd-client
          -p cua-teleport -p cua-teleport-bundle -p cua-chromium-storage -p cua-volume
          -p cua-spaces-ext -p cua-spaces-ffi -p cua-spaces-cli -- --test-threads=4
        env:
          # Teleport send acts only on fake hosts in tests; anything that
          # reaches the real host fails closed.
          CUA_ENV_TEST_SANDBOX: "1"
          # Test threads get 8 MiB, like the CLI's runtime: unoptimized
          # Windows frames are large and the CLI tests drive whole commands.
          RUST_MIN_STACK: "8388608"
      - name: Test (shared media crates and clients)
        run: >
          cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast -p cua-media-protocol -p cua-media-transport -p cua-media-client -p cua-viewer -p cua-logging

      # cua-media-codec's ScreenCaptureKit audio needs the macOS 26 SDK (the
      # spacesd CI builds it on macos-26); test the rest here.
      - name: Clippy and test (cua-media-codec)
        run: |
          features=()
          if [ "$RUNNER_OS" = "macOS" ]; then
            features=(--no-default-features --features "openh264,opus,hw")
          fi
          cargo clippy --locked -p cua-media-codec "${features[@]}" --all-targets -- -D warnings
          cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast -p cua-media-codec "${features[@]}" -- --test-threads=4
      # The streaming bench (libs/cua/bench/streaming, its own workspace) is
      # otherwise built only by the nightly bench; lint it with the SDK.
      - name: Format and clippy (streaming bench)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        working-directory: libs/cua/bench/streaming
        run: |
          cargo fmt -- --check
          cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
      # libs/cua is the client and shared-format side: it must never depend
      # on the server workspace (libs/cua-spacesd), and the media client
      # must stay free of the server/provider/platform stack.
      - name: Client/server dependency boundary
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          if cargo metadata --locked --format-version 1 | grep -o '"manifest_path":"[^"]*"' | grep 'libs/cua-spacesd/'; then
            echo "libs/cua depends on crates in libs/cua-spacesd" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          tree="$(cargo tree --locked -p cua-media-client -e normal --features media-decode)"
          if printf '%s\n' "$tree" | grep -E 'cua-spacesd|platform-(macos|windows|linux)|screencapturekit'; then
            echo "cua-media-client depends on server-side crates" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

  # The Spaces suites (cua-spaces, cua-daemon, cua-sdk) against a real
  # cua-spacesd server core in process. A standalone workspace so libs/cua
  # never depends on the driver workspace (see the boundary check above).
  spaces-e2e:
    name: spaces e2e (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 60
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-26]
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/cua-spacesd/tests/spaces-e2e
        shell: bash
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/linux-rust-prep
      - name: Install protoc
        uses: arduino/setup-protoc@c65c819552d16ad3c9b72d9dfd5ba5237b9c906b # v3.0.0
        with:
          version: "29.x"
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.97.1
        with:
          components: clippy, rustfmt
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@9d47c6ad4b02e050fd481d890b2ea34778fd09d6 # v2
        with:
          workspaces: libs/cua-spacesd/tests/spaces-e2e
          key: cua-spaces-e2e
      - name: Format
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: cargo fmt -- --check
      - name: Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
      - name: Test
        run: cargo test --locked -- --test-threads=4
        env:
          CUA_ENV_TEST_SANDBOX: "1"

  bindings:
    name: bindings drift (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-26]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/linux-rust-prep
      - name: Install protoc
        uses: arduino/setup-protoc@c65c819552d16ad3c9b72d9dfd5ba5237b9c906b # v3.0.0
        with:
          version: "29.x"
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.97.1
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@9d47c6ad4b02e050fd481d890b2ea34778fd09d6 # v2
        with:
          workspaces: libs/cua
          key: cua-sdk-bindings
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: libs/cua/typescript/package-lock.json
      - name: Install pinned UBRN
        run: npm --prefix libs/cua/typescript ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Generated bindings are up to date
        run: node libs/cua/scripts/generate-uniffi-bindings.mjs --check
      - name: Spaces contract manifest and fixtures are up to date
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        working-directory: libs/cua
        run: |
          cargo run --locked -q -p cua-spaces-contract --bin cua-spaces-contract-gen -- --check
          cargo run --locked -q -p cua-spaces --bin cua-spaces-control-fixtures -- --check

  kotlin:
    # The generated binding must compile (an exported `close` once clashed
    # with AutoCloseable.close; uniffi.toml renames such methods).
    name: kotlin compile
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    container: gradle:8.10.2-jdk17
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
      - name: Compile the generated Kotlin binding
        run: gradle --no-daemon -p libs/cua/kotlin compileKotlin

  python:
    name: python smoke (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    # A cold Windows run builds cua-sdk (release), the fixtures and the CLI:
    # it passed 45 minutes still compiling.
    timeout-minutes: 90
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-26, windows-latest]
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/linux-rust-prep
      - name: Install protoc
        uses: arduino/setup-protoc@c65c819552d16ad3c9b72d9dfd5ba5237b9c906b # v3.0.0
        with:
          version: "29.x"
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.97.1
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@9d47c6ad4b02e050fd481d890b2ea34778fd09d6 # v2
        with:
          workspaces: libs/cua
          key: cua-sdk-python
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@d0cc045d04ccac9d8b7881df0226f9e82c39688e # v6
      # The wheel ships the MIT `cua`; the suite also runs the daemon of the
      # Cua Spaces build (cua-spaces-cli), a Unix-socket test skipped on Windows.
      - name: Build the SDK, fixtures and CLIs
        working-directory: libs/cua
        run: |
          cargo build --locked --release -p cua-sdk
          scripts/build-test-fixtures.sh
          cargo build --locked -p cua-cli
          if [ "$RUNNER_OS" != Windows ]; then cargo build --locked -p cua-spaces-cli; fi
          node scripts/stage-uniffi-library.mjs --only=python
      - name: Build the platform wheel
        working-directory: libs/cua/python
        run: uv run --no-project --python 3.12 --with build python build_wheel.py --cli ../target/debug/cua --out-dir dist
      - name: Smoke-test the installed wheel
        working-directory: libs/cua/python
        run: |
          WHEEL=$(ls dist/*.whl)
          uv run --no-project --isolated --python 3.12 --with pytest --with "$WHEEL" pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests

  node:
    name: node smoke (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    # A cold macOS run (release cua-sdk, fixtures, both CLIs) passed 45
    # minutes still compiling, as python smoke did on Windows.
    timeout-minutes: 90
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-26]
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/cua
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/linux-rust-prep
      - name: Install protoc
        uses: arduino/setup-protoc@c65c819552d16ad3c9b72d9dfd5ba5237b9c906b # v3.0.0
        with:
          version: "29.x"
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.97.1
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@9d47c6ad4b02e050fd481d890b2ea34778fd09d6 # v2
        with:
          workspaces: libs/cua
          key: cua-sdk-node
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: libs/cua/typescript/package-lock.json
      - name: Build and stage
        run: |
          npm --prefix typescript ci --ignore-scripts
          cargo build --locked --release -p cua-sdk
          scripts/build-test-fixtures.sh
          cargo build --locked -p cua-cli -p cua-spaces-cli
          node scripts/stage-uniffi-library.mjs --only=node
      - name: Test
        run: npm --prefix typescript test

  browser:
    name: browser (wasm32) build + smoke
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/cua
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/linux-rust-prep
      - name: Install protoc
        uses: arduino/setup-protoc@c65c819552d16ad3c9b72d9dfd5ba5237b9c906b # v3.0.0
        with:
          version: "29.x"
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.97.1
        with:
          targets: wasm32-unknown-unknown
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@9d47c6ad4b02e050fd481d890b2ea34778fd09d6 # v2
        with:
          workspaces: libs/cua
          key: cua-sdk-browser
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: libs/cua/typescript/package-lock.json
      - name: Install wasm-bindgen 0.2.126 and UBRN
        run: |
          cargo install wasm-bindgen-cli --version 0.2.126 --locked
          npm --prefix typescript ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Build @trycua/cua/browser
        run: node scripts/build-wasm.mjs
      - name: Smoke-test the wasm build over gRPC-Web
        run: |
          scripts/build-test-fixtures.sh
          cd typescript && node --test test/browser.test.mjs

  swift:
    name: swift smoke (macOS)
    runs-on: macos-26
    # Cold, the release cua-sdk build alone nears 45 minutes on macos-26.
    timeout-minutes: 90
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: libs/cua
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
      - name: Install protoc
        uses: arduino/setup-protoc@c65c819552d16ad3c9b72d9dfd5ba5237b9c906b # v3.0.0
        with:
          version: "29.x"
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.97.1
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@9d47c6ad4b02e050fd481d890b2ea34778fd09d6 # v2
        with:
          workspaces: libs/cua
          key: cua-sdk-swift
      - name: Dev dylib
        run: |
          cargo build --locked --release -p cua-sdk
          scripts/build-test-fixtures.sh
          node scripts/stage-uniffi-library.mjs --only=swift
          swift/scripts/test.sh
      - name: spaces-sdk-swift (the CuaSpaces overlay, against the fixtures)
        working-directory: libs/spaces-sdk-swift
        env:
          CUA_REQUIRE_FIXTURES: "1"
        run: |
          ../cua/swift/scripts/fresh-abi.sh . debug

        run: |

[package]

description = "Detect AI coding agents, install the bundled cua skills into their skills directories and configure the cua MCP server in their MCP configs (idempotent, backed up, reversible)."
version.workspace = true

license.workspace = true

[dependencies]
serde.workspace = true
serde_json.workspace = true
thiserror.workspace = true
sha2.workspace = true
hex.workspace = true
# Comment- and format-preserving edits of JSON / JSONC / JSON5-ish configs.

# Comment- and format-preserving edits of TOML configs (Codex).

[dev-dependencies]

name: Monitor branded installer endpoints

# Two canaries for what users actually run:
#
#   check    the branded endpoints are served with the expected content.
#   canary   the canonical Cua Driver installers install a working, signed
#            driver with DEFAULT version resolution (no pin) on macOS, Linux,
#            and Windows, exactly as the documented one-liners do:
#              /bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"
#              & ([scriptblock]::Create((irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1))) -NoAutoStart -NoPathUpdate
#
# A failure opens (or comments on) one deduplicated `bug` issue per canary so
# a broken default install is noticed within hours, not when a user reports
# it (#4109: the installers baked a release whose macOS app was unsigned).
#
# The canary installs into temporary HOME, package-home, and bin directories.
# On macOS the installer also writes /Applications/CuaDriver.app, which is
# acceptable only because hosted runners are ephemeral. Windows runs with
# -NoAutoStart -NoPathUpdate so no scheduled task or PATH entry is created.

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "15 */6 * * *"
  release:
    types: [published]
  # The installer bake commit uses [skip ci]; follow the CD run instead so a
  # newly baked version is exercised as soon as it lands.
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["CD: Cua Driver (cross-platform)"]
    types: [completed]
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - ".github/release-state/cua-driver-rs-*"
      - ".github/workflows/monitor-branded-installers.yml"
      - "libs/cua-driver/scripts/_install-common.psm1"
      - "libs/cua-driver/scripts/_install-common.sh"
      - "libs/cua-driver/scripts/_install-rust.sh"
      - "libs/cua-driver/scripts/install.ps1"
      - "libs/cua-driver/scripts/install.sh"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: "Diagnostics only: pin this x.y.z instead of default resolution"
        required: false
        default: ""
      dry_run:
        description: "Print the issue that would be filed instead of filing it"
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write

concurrency:
  # Scheduled and event runs supersede each other; manual diagnostics never
  # cancel one another.
  group: monitor-branded-installers-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.ref }}${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && format('-{0}', github.run_id) || '' }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  # Cua programs and packages run here never send usage telemetry.
  CUA_TELEMETRY: "0"
  DO_NOT_TRACK: "1"

jobs:
  check:
    if: >-
      github.event_name != 'release' ||
      startsWith(github.event.release.tag_name, 'cua-driver-rs-v') ||
      startsWith(github.event.release.tag_name, 'lume-v')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      failures: ${{ steps.endpoints.outputs.failures }}
    steps:
      - name: Check public installer endpoints
        id: endpoints
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -uo pipefail

          endpoints=(
            "https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh|cua-driver"
            "https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1|cua-driver"
            "https://cua.ai/driver/uninstall.sh|cua-driver"
            "https://cua.ai/driver/uninstall.ps1|cua-driver"
            "https://cua.ai/driver/_install-rust.sh|cua-driver"
            "https://cua.ai/driver/_install-common.sh|cua-driver"
            "https://cua.ai/driver/_install-common.psm1|cua-driver"
            "https://cua.ai/driver/post-install-hints.txt|cua-driver"
            "https://cua.ai/lume/install.sh|Lume"
            "https://cua.ai/lume/uninstall.sh|Lume"
          )

          failures=()
          mkdir -p /tmp/branded-installer-check
          for entry in "${endpoints[@]}"; do
            url="${entry%%|*}"
            marker="${entry##*|}"
            key=$(echo "$url" | sed 's#https://##; s#[^A-Za-z0-9]#_#g')
            headers="/tmp/branded-installer-check/${key}.headers"
            body="/tmp/branded-installer-check/${key}.body"

            status=$(curl --silent --show-error --location --max-redirs 0 \
              --dump-header "$headers" --output "$body" --write-out '%{http_code}' "$url" || true)
            content_type=$(awk -F': ' 'tolower($1)=="content-type" {print $2}' "$headers" | tail -1 | tr -d '\r')

            if [[ "$status" != "200" ]]; then
              failures+=("$url returned HTTP $status")
            elif [[ "$content_type" != text/* ]]; then
              failures+=("$url returned unexpected Content-Type: ${content_type:-missing}")
            elif ! grep -qi -- "$marker" "$body"; then
              failures+=("$url did not contain expected marker $marker")
            fi
          done

          if ((${#failures[@]})); then
            {
              echo 'failures<<EOF'
              printf '%s\n' "${failures[@]}"
              echo EOF
            } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 1
          fi

          echo 'failures=' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  canary:
    name: "canonical installer / ${{ matrix.os }} (${{ github.event_name == 'push' && 'pushed scripts' || 'cua.ai' }})"
    if: >-
      github.event_name != 'release' ||
      startsWith(github.event.release.tag_name, 'cua-driver-rs-v')
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-26, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      # Pushes exercise the pushed installer and release state directly, so a
      # change is tested before the branded endpoints finish propagating it.
      # Every other trigger runs the public branded endpoints users run.
      INSTALLER_SOURCE: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && 'checkout' || 'cua.ai' }}
      CANARY_PIN: ${{ inputs.version }}
      CUA_DRIVER_RS_TELEMETRY_ENABLED: "false"
      CUA_TELEMETRY_ENABLED: "false"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            .github/release-state
            libs/cua-driver/scripts

      - name: Install Linux runtime libraries
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
            libx11-6 libxi6 libxtst6 libxext6 libwayland-client0 libxkbcommon0

      - name: Run the canonical macOS/Linux installer with default resolution
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          CANARY="$RUNNER_TEMP/cua-driver-canary"
          rm -rf "$CANARY"
          mkdir -p "$CANARY/home"
          # Isolate every per-user location the installer writes. No version
          # pin and no GitHub token: resolution is exactly what users get.
          export HOME="$CANARY/home"
          export CUA_DRIVER_RS_HOME="$CANARY/home/.cua-driver"
          export CUA_DRIVER_RS_INSTALL_DIR="$CANARY/bin"
          export CUA_DRIVER_RS_NO_MODIFY_PATH=1
          unset CUA_DRIVER_RS_VERSION CUA_DRIVER_VERSION GH_TOKEN GITHUB_TOKEN
          if [[ -n "${CANARY_PIN:-}" ]]; then
            echo "::notice::Diagnostics run pinned to ${CANARY_PIN}; this is not default resolution."
            export CUA_DRIVER_RS_VERSION="$CANARY_PIN"
          fi
          if [[ "$INSTALLER_SOURCE" == "checkout" ]]; then
            /bin/bash libs/cua-driver/scripts/install.sh 2>&1 | tee "$CANARY/install.log"
          else
            /bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)" 2>&1 | tee "$CANARY/install.log"
          fi

          INSTALLED="$CUA_DRIVER_RS_INSTALL_DIR/cua-driver"
          test -x "$INSTALLED"
          VERSION_OUTPUT=$("$INSTALLED" --version)
          echo "Installed: $VERSION_OUTPUT"
          PUBLISHED=$(tr -d '[:space:]' < .github/release-state/cua-driver-rs-published-version)
          PUBLISHED="${CANARY_PIN:-$PUBLISHED}"
          if ! grep -Fq "$PUBLISHED" <<< "$VERSION_OUTPUT"; then
            echo "::warning::Installed '$VERSION_OUTPUT', but main publishes $PUBLISHED (the branded endpoint may still be propagating)."
          fi
          if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" == "macOS" ]]; then
            APP=/Applications/CuaDriver.app
            test -x "$APP/Contents/MacOS/cua-driver"
            /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c Print:CFBundleIdentifier "$APP/Contents/Info.plist" |
              grep -Fx com.trycua.driver
            codesign --verify --deep --strict --verbose=2 "$APP"
            # Gatekeeper is what blocks a user's first launch; require the
            # notarized Developer ID assessment, not just a valid signature.
            ASSESSMENT=$(spctl -a -vvv -t exec "$APP" 2>&1)
            echo "$ASSESSMENT"
            grep -Fqx "source=Notarized Developer ID" <<< "$ASSESSMENT"
            grep -Eq '^origin=Developer ID Application: .+ \(YCK386LBJ7\)$' <<< "$ASSESSMENT"
          fi

      - name: Run the canonical Windows installer with default resolution
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $canary = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP "cua-driver-canary"
          Remove-Item -LiteralPath $canary -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          $env:CUA_DRIVER_RS_HOME = Join-Path $canary "home"
          $env:CUA_DRIVER_RS_INSTALL_DIR = Join-Path $canary "bin"
          foreach ($name in 'CUA_DRIVER_RS_VERSION', 'GH_TOKEN', 'GITHUB_TOKEN') {
            Remove-Item "Env:$name" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          }
          if ($env:CANARY_PIN) {
            Write-Host "::notice::Diagnostics run pinned to $($env:CANARY_PIN); this is not default resolution."
            $env:CUA_DRIVER_RS_VERSION = $env:CANARY_PIN
          }
          if ($env:INSTALLER_SOURCE -eq 'checkout') {
            & ./libs/cua-driver/scripts/install.ps1 -NoAutoStart -NoPathUpdate
          }
          else {
            & ([scriptblock]::Create((Invoke-RestMethod https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1))) -NoAutoStart -NoPathUpdate
          }
          $binary = Join-Path $env:CUA_DRIVER_RS_INSTALL_DIR "cua-driver.exe"
          if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $binary)) {
            throw "installer did not create $binary"
          }
          $versionOutput = & $binary --version
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "installed binary exited with $LASTEXITCODE"
          }
          Write-Host "Installed: $versionOutput"
          $published = (Get-Content -Raw .github/release-state/cua-driver-rs-published-version).Trim()
          if ($env:CANARY_PIN) { $published = $env:CANARY_PIN }
          if ($versionOutput -notmatch [regex]::Escape($published)) {
            Write-Host "::warning::Installed '$versionOutput', but main publishes $published (the branded endpoint may still be propagating)."
          }
          $signature = Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $binary
          $signature | Format-List Status, StatusMessage, SignerCertificate
          if ($signature.Status -ne 'Valid' -or $signature.SignerCertificate.Subject -notmatch 'CN="?Cua AI, Inc\.') {
            throw "installed cua-driver.exe is not validly signed by Cua AI, Inc.: $($signature.StatusMessage)"
          }

  report:
    name: Report installer canary failures
    needs: [check, canary]
    if: always() && (needs.check.result == 'failure' || needs.canary.result == 'failure')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Open or update monitoring issues
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ENDPOINT_RESULT: ${{ needs.check.result }}
          ENDPOINT_FAILURES: ${{ needs.check.outputs.failures }}
          CANARY_RESULT: ${{ needs.canary.result }}
          TRIGGER: ${{ github.event_name }}
          DRY_RUN: ${{ inputs.dry_run == true }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          RUN_URL="https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"

          # One open issue per title; later failures comment on it.
          report() {
            local title="$1" body="$2" issue_number
            if [[ "$DRY_RUN" == "true" ]]; then
              printf 'Dry run: would open or update the issue titled "%s" (label bug) with:\n%s\n' "$title" "$body"
              return
            fi
            issue_number=$(gh issue list --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --state open \
              --search "\"$title\" in:title" --json number,title \
              --jq "map(select(.title == \"$title\")) | .[0].number // empty")
            if [[ -n "$issue_number" ]]; then
              gh issue comment "$issue_number" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --body "$body"
            else
              gh issue create --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --title "$title" --label bug --body "$body"
            fi
          }

          if [[ "$ENDPOINT_RESULT" == "failure" ]]; then
            report "Branded installer endpoint check is failing" "$(cat <<EOF
          The branded installer monitor found one or more failures.

          \`\`\`
          ${ENDPOINT_FAILURES:-see the workflow run}
          \`\`\`

          Workflow run: ${RUN_URL}
          Trigger: ${TRIGGER}
          Checked at: ${GITHUB_SHA}
          EOF
          )"
          fi

          if [[ "$CANARY_RESULT" == "failure" ]]; then
            report "Cua Driver canonical installer canary is failing" "$(cat <<EOF
          The canonical Cua Driver installer failed with default version resolution on at least one platform. Fresh installs are likely broken for users on that platform.

          Workflow run: ${RUN_URL}
          Trigger: ${TRIGGER}
          Checked at: ${GITHUB_SHA}

          To roll the installers back to the last good release, follow the release safety runbook in scripts/ci/README.md.
          EOF
          )"
          fi

title: Test in CI with Cua sandboxes
description: Run tests against a Cua sandbox in GitHub Actions or any CI, inject the build under test, and fail on stale builds.
---

import { Callout } from 'fumadocs-ui/components/callout';

The `cua-sandbox` action creates a sandbox from any image, waits until it is
ready, runs your tests against it, uploads logs, the doctor report and a
screenshot, and always deletes it, even when the job is cancelled. Every step
is a plain `cua` command, so the same run works on your machine.

## GitHub Actions

```yaml test="config" id="ci-basic"
jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.97.1
      - id: sandbox
        uses: trycua/cua/.github/actions/cua-sandbox@main
        with:
          image: linux
          run: |
            cua sb exec "$CUA_SANDBOX" uname -a
            cua sb screenshot "$CUA_SANDBOX" -o "$CUA_SANDBOX_ARTIFACTS/desktop.png"
```

- `image`: a canonical image, a bench image or any registry reference.
- `on`: `local` (the default: Docker on the runner, or QEMU with KVM for VM
  images) or `cloud`. Cloud needs `CUA_CLIENT_ID` and `CUA_CLIENT_SECRET` in the
  job env. `claim-ttl` (default `60m`) is the backstop if cleanup never runs.
- `run` runs on the runner with `CUA_SANDBOX` set to the sandbox ref.
  `guest-run` runs inside the sandbox. `guest-setup` runs as root inside it
  first, for example to install test dependencies.
- `cua-version`: `source` (the default) builds the CLI from the action's ref.
  Pass `cua-bin` to use one you built.
- Outputs: `ref`, `name`, `env-url`, `viewer-url`, `urls`, `overlays`,
  `doctor-status`, `artifacts-dir`.

<Callout type="info">
Pin the action to a commit (`@<sha>`) in CI you depend on. `@main` follows the
repository.
</Callout>

## Test the code you just built

An image bundles its own cua-spacesd, and runners may have their own
cua-driver installed. To test your build instead, inject it with `overlay`:

```yaml test="config" id="ci-overlay"
      - uses: trycua/cua/.github/actions/cua-sandbox@main
        with:
          image: linux
          overlay: |
            cua-spacesd=target/release/cua-spacesd
            cua-driver=target/release/cua-driver
          expect: cua-driver=git:${{ github.sha }}
          run: ./tests/e2e.sh
```

Each overlay replaces the guest file atomically, is recorded with its sha256
and restarts what runs it. The action then runs `cua doctor` with an
expectation per overlay. The job fails before your tests run if anything else
runs, for example a daemon that was never restarted or a file replaced
afterwards. On the runner, `PATH` resolves `cua-driver` to the injected build
only, so a copy installed on the runner is never used.

## The same steps with the CLI

```bash test="cli-shape" id="ci-cli"
cua sb create linux --name ci --wait desktop \
  --overlay cua-driver=./target/release/cua-driver --json
cua doctor local:ci --no-host --only build \
  --expect cua-driver=sha256:<sha256 printed by create>
cua sb exec local:ci uname -a
cua sb rm local:ci --force
```

`--overlay` also works on a running sandbox (`cua sb overlay ci
cua-driver=PATH`) and for any file: `NAME=PATH:/guest/path`.

From Python, pass `overlay=` to `Sandbox.create`, or call `sb.overlay(...)` on
a running sandbox. `cua-driver` and `cua-spacesd` find their guest path; any
other file takes `(path, "/guest/path")`. If an overlay fails, the new sandbox
is deleted and the error raised:

```python test="container" id="ci-overlay-python" prelude="local-cleanup"
import os
import tempfile

from cua_sandbox import Image, Sandbox

tool = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), "tool")
with open(tool, "w") as f:
    f.write("#!/bin/sh\necho build-under-test\n")
os.chmod(tool, 0o755)

sb = await Sandbox.create(
    Image.from_registry("python:3.12-slim"),
    command=["sleep", "infinity"],
    runtime="runc",
    overlay={"tool": (tool, "/usr/local/bin/tool")},
)
[result] = await sb.overlay({"tool": (tool, "/usr/local/bin/tool")})
print(result.name, result.target, result.sha256)
await sb.destroy()
```

The Rust, TypeScript, Swift and Kotlin SDKs have the same `overlays` create
option and `overlay` method.

The action's steps are phases of `.github/actions/cua-sandbox/cua-sandbox.sh`,
which also runs outside GitHub. Set the inputs as `CUA_SB_*` environment
variables (for example `CUA_SB_IMAGE`, `CUA_SB_OVERLAY` and `CUA_SB_RUN`) and
run `cua-sandbox.sh all`. It cleans up on exit and on Ctrl-C.

## Expectations

`cua doctor REF --expect COMPONENT=WANT` fails unless that exact build runs.
`WANT` is one of:

- `sha256:<hex>`: the executable.
- `git:<sha>`: the source revision it was built from.
- a version.

Components are `cua-spacesd`, `cua-driver` or an overlay name. Inside the
sandbox, `cua-spacesd doctor --expect ...` does the same.

      fail-fast: false # Test all packages even if one fails
      matrix:
        package:
          - core
          - agent
          - som

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

        run: |
          pip install uv

      - name: Install package and dependencies
        run: |
          cd libs/python/${{ matrix.package }}
          # Install the package in editable mode with dev dependencies
          if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then
            uv pip install --system -e "."
          fi
        shell: bash

      - name: Install test dependencies
        run: |
          # Install test dependencies from root pyproject.toml if tests directory exists
          # The root pyproject.toml has package=false, so we install just the dependency group
          if [ -d "libs/python/${{ matrix.package }}/tests" ]; then
            uv pip install --system --group test
          fi
        shell: bash

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          cd libs/python/${{ matrix.package }}
          if [ -d tests ]; then
            python -m pytest tests/ -v --tb=short --cov --cov-report=term --cov-report=xml
          else

          fi
        shell: bash
        env:
          CUA_TELEMETRY_ENABLED: "false" # Disable telemetry during tests

        if: always()

    # hermetic suite never touches the host or a cloud;

        uses: actions/checkout@v4

          key: cua-sandbox

      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@d0cc045d04ccac9d8b7881df0226f9e82c39688e # v6

        working-directory: libs/cua
        run: |
          cargo build --locked --release -p cua-sdk
          scripts/build-test-fixtures.sh
          node scripts/stage-uniffi-library.mjs --only=python

      - name: Install cua-sandbox
        working-directory: libs/python/cua-sandbox
        run: uv sync --frozen --python 3.12

      - name: Run the hermetic suite
        working-directory: libs/python/cua-sandbox
        env:
          CUA_TELEMETRY_ENABLED: "false"

          uv run --frozen pytest tests -p no:cacheprovider --timeout=120 -ra

          --ignore=tests/test_runtime.py
          --ignore=tests/test_snapshots.py
          --ignore=tests/test_windows_cloud.py
          --ignore=tests/test_windows_timing.py
          --deselect tests/test_oci.py::TestLiveRegistry

    name: Test Summary
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [test, cua-sandbox]
    if: always()

    steps:
      - name: Check test results
        run: |
          if [ "${{ needs.test.result }}" == "failure" ] || [ "${{ needs.cua-sandbox.result }}" == "failure" ]; then
            echo "❌ Some tests failed. Please check the logs above."
            exit 1
          else

          fi

# cua-agent-setup

Agent onboarding for cua. Detects installed AI coding agents, installs the
bundled cua skills into their skills directories, and registers the cua MCP
server (`cua mcp`) in their MCP configs. Used by `cua agents ...`,
`cua auth login` onboarding, the SDK (`Cua.agent_setup()`) and the Spaces app.

## Behavior

- **Detect** (read-only): an agent is installed when one of its binaries is on
  PATH, one of its config dirs exists, or (macOS) its app bundle is in
  `/Applications` or `~/Applications`.
- **Skills**: each bundled skill is copied to `<skills dir>/<name>/`. Agents
  that read the cross-agent `~/.agents/skills` share one copy. A folder cua
  did not write, or one edited since, is skipped unless forced (the old folder
  is then kept as `<name>.cua-backup-<time>`).
- **MCP**: the config is parsed and edited structurally. JSON, JSONC and
  JSON5-style files go through a concrete syntax tree (comments, trailing
  commas and formatting kept); TOML through `toml_edit`; YAML (Goose,
  Hermes) by splicing the entry's lines under its top-level mapping, so
  comments and every other line stay byte for byte (the result must parse
  back to exactly the expected document; other layouts are edited only when
  the file has no comments to lose). Other servers are never touched. A
  malformed file is reported and left as is. The first write to each file
  takes `<file>.cua-backup-<time>`; writes are atomic, keep the file mode
  (new files are 0600) and go through symlinks.
- **State**: `~/.cua/agent-setup.json` (or `$CUA_HOME`) records each entry and
  skill folder cua wrote. `remove` deletes only entries that still hold the
  value cua wrote (restoring a pre-existing non-cua entry of the same name)
  and only skill folders nobody edited. `update` refreshes skill folders cua
  owns and re-points managed MCP entries.
- **Host safety**: everything resolves from a `HostEnv` (HOME, XDG and agent
  override variables, PATH, app folders). `HostEnv::isolated(home)` is fully
  hermetic; all tests use it with a temporary home.

## Agents

Not supported: Continue (global MCP config is a YAML list; no documented

Hermes reads `~/.agents/skills` only when it is listed in
`skills.external_dirs`, so it gets its own copies in `~/.hermes/skills`. Its
`config.yaml` is seeded from a long commented template, which the YAML splice
keeps intact. Hermes passes stdio MCP servers a filtered environment (PATH,
HOME and a few others plus the entry's `env`); `cua mcp` reads its
credentials from `~/.cua`, so it needs nothing more. Named profiles
(`hermes profile use`) are not configured: only `$HERMES_HOME` or the
default home. Hermes picks up a new server in a new session (or
`/reload-mcp`).

Cursor, OpenCode and VS Code also load `~/.claude/skills`. When Claude Code is
set up too (or cua's copies are already there), they are served from
`~/.claude/skills` and get no second copy in `~/.agents/skills`. They can still
list a skill twice when another agent that reads only `~/.agents/skills`
(Codex, for example) is set up as well.

"""Missing Python must fail before release or configuration mutation."""

import json


def test_claude_config_requires_python_before_release_is_mutated(release_install):
    f = release_install
    original = {"mcpServers": {"cua-computer-use": {"command": str(f.launcher), "args": ["mcp"]}}}
    f.write_config(original)
    f.env["PATH"] = str(f.bin)
    result = f.run()
    assert result.returncode != 0
    assert "python3 is required to safely inspect Claude MCP ownership" in result.stderr
    assert json.loads(f.config.read_text()) == original
